itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to Peru! Arrive at your hotel in Lima, the City of Kings
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day01.jpg
itinerary.description: When your flight arrives in Lima, an Unu Raymi host will welcome you personally and escort you to the hotel. Instead of navigating a new city after a long flight, let us take care of the transportation logistics. We will drop you off at your hotel so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before the real excursion starts. Relax with a good night’s rest before your flight to Puerto Maldonado in the morning.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima to Tambopata Jungle
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Puerto Maldonado and embark on your Amazon jungle adventure
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day02.jpg
itinerary.description:
Your Unu Raymi host will take you to the airport early in the morning for your flight to Puerto Maldonado. Upon arrival, you’ll be escorted by boat to the Refugio Amazonas Lodge in Tambopata for an Amazon luxury travel experience. Lunch will be served en route.

After enjoying a sunset dinner, you will venture out on a guided tour of the nocturnal rainforest. Armed with flashlights and headlamps, you will discover a world inhabited by amphibians, reptiles, and insects that have adapted to life in the darkness. After your exploration, fall asleep to a symphony of jungle sounds.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Tambopata Jungle
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on the ultimate jungle excursion
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day03.jpg
itinerary.description:
Early this morning, embark on a guided trek through the jungle past the hanging nests of Oropendola birds and fruit bats. Walk until you reach a tranquil jungle of waterways, the Oxbow Lake, with a majestic array of life swimming just under the surface. Climb aboard a traditional wooden canoe with your guide to see what wildlife you can spot! You will have a chance to see the Hoatzin, a bizarre, dinosaur-looking bird, along with troops of squirrel monkeys, rare giant otters, huge caimans, and majestic macaws flying overhead.

When your river tour is over, wave “goodbye” to the otters and start hiking through the jungle trails toward the Canopy Observation Tower, an impressive 25-meter jungle tower. Once at the top, you will have a bird’s-eye view of the magnificent forest stretching in every direction. See if you can spot monkeys, toucans, macaws, and other exotic jungle animals.

After lunch, set out to visit Don Manuel’s Amazonian farm. Here you will learn about the variety of popular and exotic Amazon produce he grows, giving you a deeper understanding of how every plant and tree you see serves a purpose.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Tambopata Jungle
itinerary.subtitle: A day enjoying jungle excursions: parrot and mammal clay licks
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day04.jpg
itinerary.description:
At dawn this morning, you will have the opportunity to spot amazing tropical birds, while learning about a strange jungle diet. You will either take a 15-minute boat ride or a 60-minute walk through the jungle to a clay lick used by parrots and parakeets. Watch the wildlife from a well-hidden viewing platform built from clay and thatch. Here, you can get a super close look at the various species of birds as they descend to munch on nutrient-rich clay. Researchers at the Macaw Project have studied these larger birds as they eat clay around the region and they believe that these animals eat the clay to supplement salt in their diet as they live far away from any ocean. Watch them enjoy their strange breakfast and see for yourself!

In the afternoon, take a short walk to another clay cliff that attracts dozens of species, especially mammals, who come to eat on the salty clay. The most well-known of these mammals are the White-Lipped Peccaries. These are wild rainforest pigs that show up in herds of 5 to 25 individuals to eat clay in the late morning. The chances of spotting them are around 15% but are well worth the short hike. Other wildlife also shows up including deer, guan, and parakeets.

Return to the lodge for one final night in the Amazonian Jungle.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Tambopata Jungle to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Cusco and travel to the Sacred Valley with stops along the way
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day05.jpg
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we will bid goodbye to the Amazon jungle as the Refugio Amazonas team will escort you back to Puerto Maldonado. From the airport, you will embark on a flight to Cusco.

Once you touch down in Cusco, an Unu Raymi host will escort you family to an inviting lunch before taking you to the Sacred Valley. The drive there will be its own adventure as we stop at the Sulca Living Museum, showcasing a comprehensive collection of ancient textile art from various Peruvian cultures. Here, you'll also have the unique opportunity to meet Peru's renowned llamas and alpacas up close!

After your visit, we will bring you to your hotel in the heart of the Sacred Valley for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Private tour of Ollantaytambo and enjoy a traditional Pachamanca feast
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day06.jpg
itinerary.description:
Start your tour of the Sacred Valley with a visit to the mysterious Ñaupa Iglesia, before continuing on to the ancient town of Ollantaytambo, where the centuries-old influence of the Incas is still very much visible. Water from the mountains trickles down to the Inca-built street canals, while the original Inca walls and trapezoidal doors are still standing.

With your guide by your side, ascend beyond the slope-side terraces to the ruins of a centuries-old fortress above the town. This is the spot where the Incas secured an important victory over the Spanish conquistadors. Inspect the intricately hewn stone constructions and have your guide show you the distant quarries from which the Incas sourced their materials. This site also affords fabulous views of the valley and the Urubamba River that meanders through it.

We hope you worked up an appetite this morning, because next on the schedule is a true Peruvian feast: the traditional Pachamanca! The centuries-old Pachamanca tradition involves marinating lamb, pork, chicken, and potatoes in a variety of Andean ingredients and cooking them to perfection in an underground oven. You’ll witness each step of the process: how the oven is prepared, how white-hot stones are layered, and how the feast materializes before your eyes!

While waiting for your feast to roast, make sure to wander through the grounds’ organic garden, smell the fresh-roasted coffee produced by the farm’s head roaster, and sample some of the varieties of cañazo (a local Andean spirit) that are produced on-site at the one-of-a-kind distillery.

Upon completion of your meal, we will bring you back to your hotel for an afternoon spent at leisure in the beautiful Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Morning train through the cloud forest on your way to visit Machu Picchu!
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day07.jpg
itinerary.description:
This is the moment all Peruvian explorers wait for. Board the train in Ollantaytambo to begin your Machu Picchu journey. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows, and see if you can spot some alpacas grazing in the valley! When you arrive in Aguas Calientes, enjoy an early lunch before ascending to the lost Incan citadel.

After a bus ride to the gates of South America’s most notable wonder, you will finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu. The incredible Inca stone citadel will reveal itself to you as you enter the main gates, a city intertwined with the clouds. Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city.

Upon conclusion of your tour, return for an evening in Aguas Calientes. Enjoy an excellent dinner on-site at your hotel and fall into bed, lulled to sleep by the sound of the cloud forest around you.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on an exclusive trek up overlooking Machu Picchu!
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day08.jpg
itinerary.description:
Today you have the option to hike two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you! This will be the culmination of your Machu Picchu luxury tour, so enjoy it however you want. Adventurous travelers who desire something off-the-beaten path should hike one of these steep slopes, offering unrivaled views of Machu Picchu. Please note that only a limited amount of hikers are allowed to climb Huayna Picchu and Machu Picchu Mountain each day and tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

In the afternoon, reconvene in Aguas Calientes and board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and bring you to your hotel for a well-earned evening of rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Uncover the secrets of Cusco’s cobblestone streets on a private city tour!
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day09.jpg
itinerary.description:
Prepare to fall in love with Cusco, a gorgeous city that wins the heart of almost every traveler that passes through it. A private tour is the best way to learn about this historic city, and get the best insider secrets! After breakfast, meet your guide and wander among the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuaman, where the Incas staged a great battle against the conquistadors. Return to the city and venture through the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, a hub of artistic inspiration. Explore Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun. Live like a local and grab some groceries in the local San Pedro market for a delightful shopping experience!

At the end of the tour, your guide will suggest a few places to enjoy a delicious lunch.

In the early afternoon, head to one of Cusco’s best restaurants and spend the afternoon learning about Peru’s culinary history and current cuisine from one of the best area chefs. You will learn how to make Peruvian starters and entrees, accompanied by a never-ending stream of snacks and samples fresh from the restaurant’s oven. Delight your palate with exotic fruits, make Pisco-based cocktails, learn the traditional Peruvian way to slice vegetables, and spend the afternoon laughing and enjoying this truly special cooking class. As the culmination of today’s class, you will sit down and dine on a traditional Peruvian dinner you prepared yourself!

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - Over the Altiplano to Titicaca
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Juliaca and visit the famous Chullpas of Sillustani on your way to Puno.
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day10.jpg
itinerary.description: This morning we will bring you to the Cusco airport for your flight to Juliaca, the jumping-off point for Lake Titicaca. From Juliaca airport, your guide will set off on a drive through the high plains of Peru. Your first stop will be the Lagoon of Umayo, where you will see ancient family tombs from the Colla Civilization called Chullpas of Sillustani. Finally, as we descend the hills into Puno, Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world, will appear before you, filling the landscape to the horizon.

itinerary.title: DAY 11 - Lake Titicaca Islands
itinerary.subtitle: Explore life on Lake Titicaca with your private tour
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day11.jpg
itinerary.description:
Today, you’ll enjoy a private tour of Lake Titicaca. Sail to the floating islands of Uros, home to an age-old community whose lineage stretches back to pre-Inca times. Thanks to their self-made reed islands, which require continual renovation, the Uros people have managed to preserve their unique way of life and survive not just the Incas and the Spanish, but also the threat of encroaching modernity. Learn about their daily lifestyle maintaining these unique islands!

Next, sail on to Taquile Island, whose residents are honored by UNESCO for their artisanal weaving skills. Eat a lunch prepared by the hospitable islanders, before returning to Puno for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 12 - Juliaca to Lima and Home
itinerary.subtitle: Tour the bohemian streets of Barranco and bid farewell to Peru!
itinerary.image: https://www.kuodatravel.com/media/Peru_Itinerary_The Amazon, Machu Picchu And Lake Titicaca_Day12.jpg
itinerary.description:
Going home is the worst part of any private Peru vacation, but at Unu Raymi, we’ll do our best to make it as smooth and hassle-free as possible. First, we’ll bring you to Juliaca airport for your return flight to Lima. In Lima, an Unu Raymi host will meet you and take you to the seaside bohemian district of Barranco. See the streets of Barranco come alive as you visit a number of local art galleries and shops that support local artisans. Finally, enjoy a first-class gourmet meal featuring world-renowned Peruvian flavors in a restaurant of your choice before returning to the airport for your journey home. Buen Viaje!

From luxury properties to boutique hotels, our staff handpicks your ideal stay to ensure you get the ultimate comfort during your travels.

title: Peru Adventure Tours
tagline: Rafting de aguas bravas, ciclismo de montaña y escalada con hoteles boutique de descanso.
overview:
Regal mountains tower over a fertile valley carved by an ancient river, whose waters seem to whisper tales of Inca glory and mystery. Ready to discover Peru? Embark on one of our unforgettable Peru adventure tours, designed to immerse you in the beauty and thrill of this extraordinary land.

From uncovering Incan secrets to indulging in exhilarating activities, this curated exploration of Peru offers a perfect balance of adventure and luxury. With our Peru adventure tours, you’ll experience the country from unique perspectives and enjoy a steady dose of adrenaline. Unleash your inner Indiana Jones on this custom, action-packed journey tailored just for you.
inclusions: Personalized itinerary planning
An Unu Raymi host to assist you in every location
The majority of meals in the itinerary
Daily activities and excursions as indicated in the itinerary
exclusions: International flights to and from your home country

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Arrive at your hotel in Lima after your international flight to Peru!
itinerary.description: When your international flight arrives in Lima, look for your Unu Raymi host holding a sign with your name on it! We know you’ll most likely be a little tired after your long flight, so we’ll save you the stress of navigating and bringing you straight to your hotel adjacent to the airport where you can shake off that icky flight feeling with a shower and a sleep. Relax into the evening and enjoy a good night’s rest before your flight to Cusco in the morning – the first stop on your Peru adventure tour!

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Cusco and make your way to the famous ruins and terraces of Pisac.
itinerary.description:
Fill up with a complimentary buffet breakfast in the hotel before catching your morning flight to Cusco. The flight time between the two cities is welcomingly short (less than an hour and a half). The views from the plane window – the desert coast at first before the needle-like peaks of the Andes come into view – are a great distraction to pass the time.

We will be waiting for you when you touch down at our Andean airport and before you can feel the altitude, we’ll whisk you into the Sacred Valley. Just an hour outside of Cusco, true Peruvian countryside will stretch away on either side of you, cows and sheep grazing tranquilly on the roadside. Impossibly steep peaks rise in the distance.

Your journey will take you to the ruins nestled in the mountains above the pueblo of Pisac, where you’ll learn about Incan agricultural practices cultivating corn and potatoes. From here, you’ll be able to see the verdant farmland where the Incas once cultivated their crops and where modern-day Quechua people continue to farm.

From here, you’ll descend on a leisurely hike through terraces and breathtaking scenery to the quaint town of Pisac for a delicious lunch. After your meal, we will bring you to your hotel in the heart of the Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Adrenaline Thrills in the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Zoom through the valley and climb a cliff to the Skylodge
itinerary.description:
Today’s journey through the Sacred Valley of the Incas will start with an ATV adventure, taking you at high speeds through rural paths and agricultural lands. Once you’ve got the lay of the land from a high-speed vehicle on firm ground, it’s time to head into the air.

Enjoy a fresh, gourmet lunch, and receive a safety briefing on the harnesses and helmets that will become like your second skin tonight. Masterfully climb your way up what seems like a sheer cliff face, using steel rungs as your guide. After a 1,500 ft. ascent, you’ll arrive at your one-of-a-kind luxury hotel for the evening – a glass pod dangling off the cliff face, providing 300-degree views of the Sacred Valley below you!

Although it may surprise some, be prepared for a well-earned and truly gourmet meal, enjoyed with a fine glass of red wine and the best possible scenery. Marvel at the thousands of stars visible above you – you might even call this a thousand-star hotel – and tuck yourself into your comfy bed complete with a real mattress and cozy down comforter.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Zip Lines and Equines
itinerary.subtitle: Zip back down and spend the afternoon on horseback
itinerary.description:
Wake up to one of the best views ever and look around you – did you forget you slept hundreds of meters in the air in a capsule bolted to a cliff? Enjoy an al fresco breakfast and get ready to zip back down the mountain.

Through six zip lines crisscrossing the path you took yesterday to arrive at your one-of-a-kind suite, you’ll return to the valley floor. Bid your harness and helmet farewell and we’ll bring you for a delicious lunch of local flavors surrounded by the beauty of the Andes.

This afternoon, experience spectacular views of the legendary Salineras salt mines, as well as other majestic scenery including gorges and mountains in the saddle. At the end of your ride, we’ll bring you back to your hotel for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - In the Footsteps of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Trek along the famous Inca Trail to the Citadel of Machu Picchu
itinerary.description:
Today, prepare to walk in the footsteps of the Inca and arrive proudly on foot at Machu Picchu. We’ll collect you from your hotel bright and early this morning and drive through the picturesque Sacred Valley to the train station in Ollantaytambo, where we’ll board the luxury Vistadome train.

You and your guide will disembark the train at the Inca Trail trailhead found at Kilometer 104, and from here you will walk the lovely uphill path to the ruins of Wiñaywayna. As you walk, your guide will point out orchids and other jungle plants, the Urubamba River will rush below you, and you’ll marvel at the Inca’s strength and ingenuity. When you reach the ruins of Wiñaywayna, you’ll rest up, explore, and enjoy a delicious al fresco lunch. Then you’ll hit the trail once again! A walk of approximately two hours brings you to Inti Punku, the famous Sun Gate.

You’ll approach this stone construction up one last flight of stairs, catch your breath, and then lose it again as you catch your first glimpse of Machu Picchu, nestled and hidden between steep peaks below you.

Descend triumphantly over ancient paving stones to the lost citadel, and relish in the audacity of a construction of this caliber in this stunning location before catching the bus to Aguas Calientes and checking in to your hotel. Your guide will then leave you to rest, refresh, and enjoy a delicious and well-earned dinner on-site.

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Prepare for a climactic day in the Inca Citadel!
itinerary.description:
After a bus ride to the gates of this wonder of the world, you will pass through the main gates with your private guide to finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu. The incredible Inca stone construction will be spread below, alternately hidden and revealed by clouds. Your expert guide will lead you on a private tour of the ancient city.

Today you also have the option to hike one of two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you how you would like to culminate your Machu Picchu luxury tour. Please note that only a limited number of hikers are allowed to climb Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain each day, and so tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

After your visit, descend to Aguas Calientes for lunch before you board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and bring you to your hotel in Cusco for a well-deserved good night’s rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Exploring The Imperial City
itinerary.subtitle: Explore Cusco’s hills on two wheels and its hidden cobblestone streets on foot
itinerary.description:
This morning it’s off to explore the hills surrounding Cusco via mountain bike! Strap on your helmet and it’s off we go, through the greater Sacsayhuaman National Park. Keep an eye out for unmarked and seldom-visited Incan ruins.

After lunch, you’ll continue your journey through Cusco – a picturesque city that is loved by travelers from all over the world. Wander through the cobblestone streets in the company of your guide who will help illuminate the history of this colonial city. As you explore the city’s sights, Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun, Cusco’s striking cultural blend will soon become apparent.

Roam the atmospheric streets of the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, which is known for its free-spirited scene; see where the locals make their grocery runs at the open-air San Pedro market and pass the famous 12-angled stone, whose image appears on the bottle of the local Cusqueña beer.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Peru’s White Water
itinerary.subtitle: Navigate Peru’s white water in the Southern Valley
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, your private driver will meet you at your hotel and whisk you over the hills surrounding Cusco into the beautiful purple countryside beyond. You’ll pass fields with grazing cows and sheep, adobe houses, and colonial churches. Enjoy the feeling of freedom in the country air.

After approximately ninety minutes, you’ll arrive in the small town of Chuquicahuana where you will receive a safety briefing with procedures for the start of your adventure at the Upper Urubamba River. Here, you will work together to prepare the equipment and inflate the rafts before gearing up and climbing in.

You’ll spend three hours navigating the river as a team and taking in the stunning scenery – dry mountains, green fields, small farmsteads, and an incredibly big blue sky. You’ll even take on class III and class IV rapids, so prepare to get a little wet.

When you disembark, relish an al fresco lunch and then relax as we drive you back to your hotel in Cusco for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - See the Rainbow for Yourself!
itinerary.subtitle: High-altitude Hike to the Colorful Vinicunca
itinerary.description:
Today will start early in the morning, so make sure to get a good night’s rest! We’ll pick you up before sunrise for a drive of approximately three and half hours through small communities on the outskirts of the district of Cusco.

Once we arrive to the trailhead, you’ll disembark from the vehicle and begin your hike. Passing small communities and local farmers who are fiercely proud of their gorgeous surroundings, breathe in the fresh mountain air and go at your own pace – while the trail is not difficult or rife with technicalities, the high altitude requires a slow and steady pace. After approximately three hours of hiking through stunning scenery, you’ll begin a final ascent to the Rainbow Mountain lookout.

While difficult, the last hundred meters will have a dramatic reward. Once up top, make sure to catch your breath and pause for a photo that encapsulates all the colors of the rainbow with the mountains as your background.

You’ve made it to over 17,000 ft. above sea level! When you are ready, make the return trek on the same path you came in on – this time, you’ll have plenty of energy to look around, and truly take in the full splendor of Peru’s colored mountains. When you arrive at the end of your hike, we’ll bring you back on a leisurely drive through curving roads to Cusco, where you can spend an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - Return to the Capital
itinerary.subtitle: Return to “The City of Kings” for an afternoon of paragliding.
itinerary.description:
This morning, you can continue your exploration of the city of Cusco, or have a lie-in and enjoy the comforts of your hotel. At the appropriate time mid-day, we will bring you to the Cusco airport for your return flight to Lima. Your Unu Raymi Lima host will meet you upon arrival and bring you to Miraflores pier, where your instructor will give you a safety briefing for your tandem paragliding tour.

Take a running leap of faith into the air and enjoy the spectacular views over the ocean and the seaside district of Miraflores, where you will find manicured parks and laid-back surfers, all overlooking one of Lima’s most popular neighborhoods. After your flight, you’ll have some free time to explore at leisure and grab a bite to eat at one of the neighborhood's award-winning restaurants.

itinerary.title: DAY 11 - Soaring Over Ancient Mysteries
itinerary.subtitle: Soar over a 2,000-year-old mystery and surf the sand dunes of Huacachina
itinerary.description:
After you’ve finished a nutritious breakfast, your guide and private driver will meet you at your hotel. Then, it’s through the arid but beautiful countryside on a road trip adventure. After approximately four hours you will reach Ica, where you will board the small plane ready to take you soaring over the world-renowned Nazca Lines.

Created by the Nazca people between 400 and 650AD, the purpose of these massive earthworks is still shrouded in mystery. Experts suspect they were related to Nazca cosmology and religious worship, but you can form your own hypothesis as you fly above them! You’ll touch back down after approximately 90 minutes and make your way to the iconic oasis of Huacachina.

This oasis – crystal clear water and palm trees surrounded by sand as far as the eyes can see – is home to some of the best dune buggy adventures in the world. Grab your sunglasses and strap in for a wild ride. Cruise over the dunes and partake in a thrilling sandboarding lesson before pausing to watch the sunset over the expanse of dunes.

Return to the oasis where your private vehicle will be waiting to bring you to your hotel in Paracas, approximately 40 minutes away.

itinerary.title: DAY 12 - Peru’s Mini-Galapagos
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the Ballestas Islands and Paracas Natural Reserve
itinerary.description:
Paracas, with its incredible biodiversity, beautiful coastal landscapes, and remote location is often referred to as Peru’s “mini Galapagos”. A treasure of a destination, Paracas will give you the experience of getting up close and personal with Peru’s coastal wildlife: we’ll meet you in the hotel lobby and then bring you to the Paracas Peninsula harbor. We’ll board a speedboat and enjoy a scenic ride through an area often called the “Mini-Galapagos of Peru”. Here, the cold plankton-rich Humboldt Current meets warmer tropical waters, creating ideal feeding grounds for a host of wildlife: pelicans, flamingoes, Inca terns, sea lions, penguins, hammerhead sharks, and even whales. As we speed toward the islands, you’ll see the mysterious ancient earthwork – the Candelabro.

Your guide will expand on the various theories about its creation and meaning, although no one has yet convincingly illuminated its past. You’ll return to port after approximately 35 minutes and make your way back to your private car, where you will enjoy a relaxing drive back to the capital.

At the appropriate time, we will bring you to the airport for your journey home. Your host will help you to check in to your international flight and wish you buen viaje!

Get in touch with Unu Raymi today and we’ll start crafting your very own customized adventure travel experience to Peru!

highlights: Fly over the southern coastal desert to witness an international unsolved mystery from above: The Nazca Lines .

Travel by ATV through mountainous terrain and local farming communities finishing with a refreshing chicha.
Scale 400 meters up the jagged rock face to sleep as the condors do in the Skylodge, ziplining back in the morning.

title: Peru Culinary Tours
tagline: Un viaje sensorial desde los 50 Best Restaurants en Lima hasta la cocina ancestral andina.
overview:
Peruvian cuisine, celebrated by world-renowned chefs like Gastón Acurio and Virgilio Martínez, has earned Peru the title of the world’s top culinary destination. Let the flavors speak for themselves on one of our exclusive Peru culinary tours, where your taste buds lead the way.

From dining at some of the world’s best restaurants to cooking with an award-winning chef, every moment of this journey is a celebration of gastronomy. Pair Pisco with gourmet hors d’oeuvres, sample giant-kernelled Incan corn, savor a feast from an earthen oven, or try flambéing “lomo saltado” yourself. These Peru culinary tours invite you to explore a world of flavors, culture, and creativity. ¡Buen Provecho!
inclusions: Personalized itinerary planning

The majority of meals in the itinerary

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to Peru! Arrive at your hotel in Lima, the City of Kings.
itinerary.description: When your flight arrives in Lima, an Unu Raymi host will welcome you personally and escort you to the hotel. Instead of navigating a new city after a long flight, let us take care of the transportation logistics. We will drop you off at your hotel so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before the real excursion starts. Relax with a good night’s rest before your flight to Puerto Maldonado in the morning.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - The City of Kings
itinerary.subtitle: Private tour of Lima’s Historic Center and Larco Herrera Museum.
itinerary.description:
Wake up refreshed and enjoy breakfast in your hotel this morning. You have the morning to spend at your leisure, exploring the vibrant neighborhood of Miraflores, a foodie paradise.

At the appropriate time mid-day, we’ll collect you and bring you to the Pueblo Libre neighborhood, home to the Larco Herrera Museum. Housing the country’s largest collection of pre-Columbian artifacts, including extensive gold and silver collections, as well as the infamous erotic archaeological collection and providing rare open access to their exquisitely cataloged storage area, this museum is the perfect introduction to Peru’s multi-faceted cultural history.

First, you’ll begin your visit with a delicious lunch enjoyed on the vine-covered terrace of the museum’s café, and then you’ll have time to explore the exhibits.

Next, we’ll delve into the heart of Peru’s “City of Kings,” where you’ll visit the Plaza Mayor, featuring the current President’s palace, the Convent of San Francisco (including subterranean catacombs!), and the Casa Aliaga, which is the western hemisphere’s oldest mansion and still owned and inhabited by the 17th generation of the Aliaga family.

Upon completion of your tour, we will bring you to an exclusive, highly praised restaurant in Lima such as Central or Maido, both currently on the World’s 50 Best Restaurants list.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Lima To Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Cusco to tour a local hacienda and stop by the agricultural ruins of Pisac
itinerary.description:
We’ll escort you back to the airport for your morning flight to Cusco . Watch the windows as the desert coast rises into the snow-capped peaks of the Andes!

Your journey will take you to an old hacienda, nestled in the fertile valley next to the pueblo of Pisac. Step onto the family-owned hacienda grounds and step into centuries past while your hosts expound upon the growing process of Giant White Corn and its profound cultural significance in the Andes Mountains. This hacienda dates back generations, and you’ll immediately be immersed in local customs steeped in the spirits and mysticism of the Andes, and embraced by the warmth of local Peruvians.

Relish your time on the farm with a delicious multi-course lunch with sample dishes featuring none other than the “white gold” giant-kernelled corn, and make sure to visit the on-site stables housing the renowned Peruvian Paso horses. Watch the horses dance with their human counterparts in a “marinera” demonstration and even go for a quick trot yourself if you feel up to the task.

From there, your exclusive tour of Peru will take you to the valley town of Pisac, with one more archaeological site visit, this time to the abandoned mountainside ruins of the original Inca Pisac village. Look out across verdant Inca farmland that has since been transformed into agricultural farms for modern-day Quechua people. Later, return to the hotel of your choice.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Hike through the valley, learning to make local Andean treats
itinerary.description:
This morning you’ll enjoy scenic views of the legendary Salineras salt mines, as well as other majestic sights including gorges and mountains. Then learn about and take part in the making of an ancient and invigorating drink: Chicha de Jora, a traditional corn beer and learn to make Uchucuta, A blend of flavors and ancient traditions.

After a delicious farm to table lunch exploring local flavors, we will bring you to your hotel for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Delving Into the Heart of the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring Ollantaytambo and train to Aguas Calientes
itinerary.description:
Today, we will take you to the ancient town of Ollantaytambo, one of the few remaining places in Peru that retains its original Incan urban planning. You’ll note still-functioning street canals, multi-family houses with secret interior courtyards and iconic Incan trapezoidal doors! Here we’ll visit the Incan fortress perched on the mountainside overlooking the sleepy pueblo, and learn about nearby stone quarries and the pivotal Incan battle fought here.

We hope you worked up an appetite this morning, because next on the schedule is a true Peruvian feast: the traditional Pachamanca! The centuries-old Pachamanca tradition involves marinating lamb, pork, chicken, and potatoes in a variety of Andean ingredients and cooking them to perfection in an underground oven.

This afternoon, we’ll make our way to the train station in Ollantaytambo, where we’ll board the first-class Vistadome train to Aguas Calientes. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows!

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Private tour of Machu Picchu
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu
itinerary.description:
This is your day to enjoy a private tour of Machu Picchu. In the morning after breakfast in your hotel, you and your guide will board the bus to the entrance of the ruins. You will then ascend stone steps, through heavy tree cover to finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu! Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city, introducing you to the history of this spectacular citadel and showing you the most important temples and ceremonial sites.

After completing your Machu Picchu visit you will descend to Aguas Calientes for lunch and your return Vistadome train. We will be waiting to collect you in the Ollantaytambo train station and will bring you to your hotel in the Sacred Valley for the evening.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Agriculture in the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Agriculture of the Andes in the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
This morning, you’ll embark on a unique culinary adventure with Manuel Choque, a visionary farmer who has revolutionized the cultivation of Andean potatoes. On his farm, you will not only see potatoes in surprising colors and shapes, but you will learn about their ancestral value and how Manuel has reinvented these tubers to turn them into superfoods of the future. From potato tastings to innovative liquors, this experience is a feast of Andean flavors and knowledge that will make you see the potato like never before.

At the end of your delicious farm-to-table lunch, we will bring you to your hotel in the Sacred Valley for an afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring the Inca Capital and its culinary delights
itinerary.description:
Explore the hidden cobblestone streets of historical Cusco and taste your way through the most iconic Peruvian products. It’s time to get acquainted with Cusco, a picturesque city that is loved by travelers from all over the world. Wander through the cobblestone streets in the company of your guide who will help illuminate the history of this colonial city. As you explore the city’s sights, Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun, Cusco’s striking cultural blend will soon become apparent.

Roam the atmospheric streets of the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, which is known for its free-spirited scene; see where the locals make their grocery runs at the open-air San Pedro market and pass the famous 12-angled stone, whose image appears on the bottle of the local Cusqueña beer.

At the end of the tour, your guide will suggest places to enjoy a delicious light local lunch, but make sure to save some room for the snacks that await you in your Peru culinary tour this afternoon.

In the early afternoon, continue with your Peru culinary tour by heading to one of Cusco’s best restaurants and spending the afternoon learning about Peru’s culinary history and current cuisine from one of the best area chefs. You will learn how to make Peruvian starters and entrees, accompanied by a never-ending stream of snacks and samples fresh from the restaurant’s oven.

Delight your palate with exotic fruits, make Pisco-based cocktails, learn a traditional way to slice vegetables, and spend the afternoon laughing and enjoying this truly special cooking class.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Exploring the South Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Learn breadmaking in Oropesa and explore the site of Tipon
itinerary.description:
This morning you’ll visit the pueblo of Oropesa, an historic community famous throughout Peru for its artisan bread. Let the aroma of fresh-out-of-the-oven breads lure you in to our friend’s private bakery, and learn the secrets of the Oropesa bread makers from a true master! After a morning preparing and sampling giant Peruvian bread rounds, you’ll visit the archeological site of Tipon, a true testament to Inca ingenuity and water engineering!

You’ll then enjoy a delicious lunch of local flavors before exploring a unique miniature village right in the Southern Valley.

This evening, you’ll discover the fascinating world of Pisco through our exciting Cusco Pisco Tasting experience. Immerse yourself in the history, characteristics, and production process of this iconic Peruvian spirit while enjoying the best Cusco culinary experience!

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - Bidding Farewell to Peru!
itinerary.subtitle: Unique food tour before your flight to Lima for your international flight home
itinerary.description:
This morning, eat your way through the streets during your last morning here! Explore the vibrant San Pedro Market and the charming side streets while visiting some of the best food stalls in Cusco, where you'll get to taste some delicious local specialties from chicha de quinoa to cherimoya!

At the appropriate time this afternoon, we will escort you to the Cusco airport for your return flight to Lima. Watch the windows as the snow-capped peaks of the Andes become coastal desert. We will help you check in for your international flight and wish you buen viaje!

Wine and dine your way to Machu Picchu , Peru’s ancient lost citadel

Visit indigenous markets where you can sample local spices, peculiar concoctions, and exotic fruits!

title: Peru Family Travel
tagline: Aventuras enriquecedoras y flexibles para unir generaciones a través de los Andes.
overview:
Discover Peru’s most bucket-list-worthy destinations with our exclusive Peru family travel experiences. Venture across the Amazon and Andes, exploring unspoiled nature and fascinating historic sites from vanished civilizations.

Begin your journey in the Amazon jungle, observing diverse wildlife in this enchanting and serene rainforest. After immersing yourself in the wonders of the jungle, travel into the heart of the Inca Empire. Meet local artisans and adorable camelids in the Sacred Valley, take in breathtaking views of the sharp Andean peaks, and marvel at the mystical Machu Picchu. Conclude your Peru family travel adventure in Cusco, a city where Inca, colonial, and modern influences blend seamlessly.

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to Peru! Arrive at your hotel in Lima, the City of Kings.
itinerary.description: When your flight arrives in Lima, an Unu Raymi host will welcome you personally and escort you to the hotel. Instead of navigating a new city after a long flight, let us take care of the transportation logistics. We will drop you off at your hotel so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before the adventure truly begins. Relax with a good night’s rest before your flight to Puerto Maldonado in the morning.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima to Tambopata
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Puerto Maldonado where the Amazon expedition begins.
itinerary.description:
In the morning, your Unu Raymi host will escort you to the airport for a flight to Puerto Maldonado. A travel guide from your jungle hotel will be waiting when you land and captain the boat to the Inkaterra Reserva Amazonica lodge. Upon arrival, you will be served a delicious lunch with fresh-pressed juices.

Embark on a guided jungle walk along the Reserva Amazonica natural area, where you will find Shihuahuaco trees that can grow to the heights of 50 meters (164 feet) and a diameter of 1 meter (3.3 feet) over the course of 700 years. Learn about the strangler fig trees, or matapalos, and spot exotic jungle birds and insects.

As the sun sets, enjoy a twilight river excursion watching the jungle transform into an energetic nocturnal world. Spot unique mammals, amphibians, reptiles, and insects that thrive in the darkness, and enjoy their peaceful songs as you fall asleep in the ecolodge.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Tambopata Jungle
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on the ultimate jungle excursion.
itinerary.description:
After a serene sunrise breakfast, sail to Lake Sandoval, gliding along the jungle river in a wooden canoe. Drift on a captivating oxbow lake and see if you can spot one of the endangered river otters. Other wild inhabitants here include red howler monkeys, red-bellied macaws, anacondas, sick-neck turtles, and more.

Nourish yourself with an energizing lunch before exploring the Inkaterra Canopy Walkway. Here, you’ll wander across eight observation platforms, located 30 meters high in the jungle canopies, linked by suspension bridges. Be on the lookout for toucans, woodpeckers, trogons, monkeys, and the three-toed sloth. After your descent, stroll along the Anaconda Walk and observe various species of amphibians, birds, mammals, and the lush foliage of this seasonally flooded marshland.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Tambopata Jungle
itinerary.subtitle: Trek the dark-water creek and take a daring late-night jungle excursion.
itinerary.description:
It’s another early morning today, as you set off to investigate Gamitana creek. Embrace the exciting wildlife research opportunities on this winding dark-water creek, home to piranhas, caiman, turtles, and birds. Afterward, visit Gamitana Model Farm and learn about Amazonian agriculture. You’ll even get the chance to make your own plantain flour used to make bread back at the lodge.

After lunch, take the 35-minute boat ride upstream to the Hacienda Concepcion – an extraordinary botanical garden with over 200 different species of flora and fauna. After a calming afternoon, prepare for a daring Rainforest by Night experience hosted by the Inkaterra Ecological Reserve. Venture into the forest and spot creatures that only come out to play at night.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Tambopata Jungle to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Cusco, visit a local project that promotes sustainable weaving practices and relax in the breathtaking Andean countryside.
itinerary.description: After breakfast, we will bid goodbye to the Amazon jungle as the Refugio Amazonas team will escort you back to Puerto Maldonado. From the airport, you will embark on a flight to Cusco. Once you land, a guide will accompany you to the stunning Sacred Valley, whose bucolic farming and weaving towns – a few thousand feet lower in elevation than Cusco – are ideal for acclimatizing. On the way to the valley, stop at Sulca Living Museum, showcasing a comprehensive collection of ancient textile art from various Peruvian cultures. Here, you'll also have the unique opportunity to meet Peru's renowned llamas and alpacas up close!

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Visit Ollantaytambo’s iconic ruins and enjoy an earth oven lunch.
itinerary.description:
This morning, spend a special hour on horseback, away from the crowds and losing yourself in the stunning views of the rural Sacred Valley. After a safety briefing and meeting your horse, we’ll show you our neighborhood, a beautiful section of the Sacred Valley that just a few get to see. There are no popular tourist attractions on this route, which is why this is an unforgettable and peaceful way to experience rural life in the Sacred Valley.

Then for lunch, you’ll experience a traditional Pachamanca! The pachamanca is a culinary tradition that dates back to the Incas as a way to celebrate and pay respect to the Pachamama or Mother Earth, a deity representing fertility to the indigenous people in Peru. The Pachamanca is a real feast that plays a key role in gatherings in different regions of Peru.

Thie afternoon, you will get your hands dirty and learn all about the building traditions of the Sacred Valley with an adobe making workshop. Surrounded by colorful mountains, our local experts in mud brick making will share their first-hand knowledge about this building tradition. With their help, you’ll make some strong mud mix yourself!

After getting cleaned up, we will bring you to your hotel for an afternoon at leisure in the beautiful Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Relax with a morning train through the cloud forest on your way to visit Machu Picchu!
itinerary.description:
This is the moment all Peruvian explorers wait for. Board a luxurious train in Ollantaytambo and watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows. See if you and the kids can spot some alpacas grazing in the valley outside. The second leg of your trip to Machu Picchu will be a short bus ride. Upon arrival, enjoy a small lunch to give you energy for your exploration of the Inca citadel.

Your luxury tour of Machu Picchu continues after lunch as you and your family enter the ancient site. Seeing the astonishing Inca stonework in person will surpass any and every expectation you may have. An expert guide will take the family on a private tour of the cloud-level citadel, explaining the history and secrets of this mysterious ancient city.

Return to Aguas Calientes this evening and fall asleep to the sound of the humming cloud forest around you.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on an exclusive trek up the lovely Huchuy Picchu Mountain
itinerary.description:
Today you have the option to hike Huchuy Picchu, which means ‘Little Mountain’ in Quechua, which is an archaeological jewel, combining Inca history with beautiful natural landscapes.

In the afternoon, reconvene in Aguas Calientes and board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and bring you to your hotel for a well-deserved good night’s rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Uncover the secrets of Cusco’s cobblestone streets on a private city tour!
itinerary.description:
Prepare to fall in love with Cusco, a gorgeous city that wins the heart of almost every traveler that passes through it. A private tour is the best way to learn about this historic city and uncover the best insider secrets. Your guide will meet you at your hotel, and from there you’ll start your exploration of the city! Explore the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuaman, where the Incas staged a great battle against the conquistadors, the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, a hub of artistic inspiration, and Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun, enjoying local snacks and tasty treats along the way!

At the end of the tour, you will be free to explore our vibrant city on your own! Take a chocolate-making workshop, see the stars as the Incas saw them with an evening at the planetarium, or simply stroll and absorb the excitement of being in a new place!

overview:
Embark on the ultimate Peru family vacation, discovering the best family-friendly destinations throughout this fascinating country. Parents and children alike will uncover the secrets of Peru during this unforgettable journey through history and culture.

Explore the Sacred Valley of the Incas, where unique traditions from ancient times come to life. Let your little ones marvel at the evocative ruins of Machu Picchu. Stroll through the vibrant streets of Cusco, a living gallery of Incan and Hispanic history. Indulge in a sweet treat at the Chocolate Museum before heading to Lima, the City of Kings. No matter your age, a Peru family vacation will invigorate your senses and create cherished memories to last a lifetime.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - From the Coast to the Andes
itinerary.subtitle: Fly from Lima to Cusco and travel to the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
After a restful night’s sleep, enjoy a complimentary breakfast buffet in the hotel before embarking on your journey to Cusco. It’s a short flight, and the kids will be kept entertained by the mystifying views of the Andes out the plane window.

Once you touch down in Cusco, an Unu Raymi host will escort you family to an inviting lunch before taking you to the Sacred Valley. The drive there will be its own adventure as we stop at the Sulca Living Museum, showcasing a comprehensive collection of ancient textile art from various Peruvian cultures. Here, you'll also have the unique opportunity to meet Peru's renowned llamas and alpacas up close!

After a delicious lunch en route, we will bring you to your hotel for an evening at leisure in the beautiful Sacred Valley.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Kayak on the calm waters of Lake Piuray and craft Peruvian-inspired ceramics
itinerary.description:
Today we will add both adventure and art to your family vacation to Peru. After breakfast, you will head to the shores of Lake Piuray for a morning of fun in the water. The whole family will receive a quick safety lesson before climbing aboard the kayak and paddling through tranquil waters, an excellent place to study the local flora and fauna! Once you return to dry land, enjoy a delicious picnic lunch.

You’ll then get a chance to get up close and personal with local animals including guinea pigs, cows, burros, and the beloved alpaca named Valicha.

Next, you’ll paint local stones or traditional toritos (small bulls), making your very own souvenir to bring home!

itinerary.subtitle: Relaxing morning train on your way to visit Machu Picchu

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on an exclusive trek overlooking the citadel
itinerary.description:
Today you have the option to hike two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you! This will be the culmination of your Machu Picchu luxury tour, so enjoy it however you want. Adventurous travelers who desire something off-the-beaten-path can hike the steep slope of Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, offering unrivaled views of Machu Picchu. Please note that only a limited number of hikers are allowed to climb these routes each day and tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

In the afternoon, reconvene in Aguas Calientes and board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and take you to your hotel in Cusco for a well-deserved good night’s rest.

itinerary.subtitle: Uncover the secrets of Cusco’s cobblestone streets
itinerary.description:
Prepare to fall in love with Cusco, a gorgeous city that wins the heart of almost every traveler that passes through it. A private tour is the best way to learn about this historic city and uncover the best insider secrets.

Your guide will meet you at your hotel, and from there you’ll start your exploration of the city! Explore the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuaman, where the Incas staged a great battle against the conquistadors, the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, a hub of artistic inspiration, and Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun, enjoying local snacks and tasty treats along the way!

This afternoon, make your way to the Chocolate Museum for a sweet afternoon. You are in the birthplace of chocolate, so this is a fantastic chance to learn about the rich, beloved treat. You’ll even get the chance to make your own chocolate truffles, a delectable souvenir.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Cusco to Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Return to the City of Kings and enjoy water-filled fun!
itinerary.description:
This morning, we’ll transport you to the Cusco airport for a morning flight to Lima, the finale of your family vacation to Peru. As you soar through the skies, remember to peek out the window to watch the snow-dusted Andes give way to the coastal desert. Upon arrival in Lima, your Unu Raymi Lima host will meet you and bring you to your hotel in Lima’s Miraflores district.

In the evening, change into something you don’t mind getting wet as you’ll be heading to Lima’s “Magical Water Circuit.” Set in a city park, this fountain display is a perfect family adventure. The choreographed light, water, and sound showcases are a marvel to behold, and many of the fountains are interactive. Your whole family will cherish the memories of splashing around in these colorful fountains.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Lima to Home
itinerary.subtitle: Meeting Peru’s Paso Horses before Bidding Farewell to Peru
itinerary.description:
This morning you can sleep in, enjoy your hotel’s pool, or explore the Miraflores boardwalk at your leisure. At the appropriate time late this morning, we’ll collect you and bring you to the Lurin area of Lima for an unforgettable equestrian lunch experience! First you’ll be welcomed to a traditional hacienda, famous for breeding Peru’s fine-step horses. Wander the grounds and stables and learn about the Colonial and Republican periods of Peruvian history, and say “hi” to any foals that have recently arrived! Come lunchtime you’ll enjoy an al-fresco catered meal on the hacienda grounds before the iconic snare drum and trumpets of traditional Marinera music begin.

Prepare to be wowed by an equestrian demonstration, watching as the horses deftly pick up their hooves to the rhythm of the music and genuinely dance with their human counterparts. If you’re feeling up for it afterward, hop in the saddle yourself and give the world’s smoothest-gait horse a trot, led by an authentic “Chalan” at the reins!

Upon conclusion of your meal, bid the horses and hacienda farewell before we return to Miraflores. You’ll have the remainder of the afternoon and evening at leisure (we are happy to secure dinner reservations for you at your restaurant of choice!) before we bring you back to the Lima airport for your international journey home. Thank you for traveling with Unu Raymi Expeditions, and buen viaje!

title: Machu Picchu Vacation
tagline: El viaje familiar más completo: Costa, Selva Amazónica, Andes y Machu Picchu.
overview:
Embark on a 14-day Machu Picchu vacation and family adventure through Southern Peru, a land rich in history and breathtaking landscapes. Begin in Lima, exploring the City of Kings with its vibrant fountains and dazzling light displays.

Fly to Arequipa, the “White City,” before heading to Chivay for a scenic visit to the Colca Canyon, where majestic Andean condors glide through the skies. Discover the magical islands of Lake Titicaca, ride the luxurious Peru Rail Titicaca Train to Cusco, and experience a heartwarming homestay in Umasbamba. Enjoy a horseback adventure in the Sacred Valley, visit Ollantaytambo, and culminate your journey at the iconic Machu Picchu. This Machu Picchu vacation blends exploration and relaxation, creating unforgettable moments for the entire family.

Join us on this captivating journey through the heart of Peru, where history and culture come alive in every step.

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Welcome to Peru!
itinerary.subtitle: International arrival in Lima
itinerary.description: You will find us waiting for you when your international flight arrives in Lima. Look for the Unu Raymi sign with your name and smile. We will escort you to your hotel in the Miraflores district, check you in, and help you get settled. You’ll then be able to rinse away the feeling of a long flight and enjoy a good night’s rest!

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Introduction to the City of Kings
itinerary.subtitle: City tour of Lima and Visit the Magical Water Circuit
itinerary.description:
Today, you’ll explore Peru’s “City of Kings,” where you’ll visit the Plaza Mayor, featuring the current President’s palace, the Convent of San Francisco (including subterranean catacombs!) and the Casa Aliaga, which is the western hemisphere’s oldest mansion and still owned and inhabited by the 17th generation of the Aliaga family.

You’ll have the early afternoon to explore at leisure. After dark, change into clothes that can get wet and bring a towel! You’ll be heading to Lima’s “Magical Water Circuit”. Combining water, movement, light, images, and sound, this park is the largest of its kind in the world! You’ll not only be able to view the fountains, you can also interact with them, getting wet as you go!

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Lima to Arequipa
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Arequipa and Explore the White City
itinerary.description: This morning you’ll fly to Arequipa and explore Peru’s “white city”. You’ll stroll through the shining center of town, with many buildings made from a white volcanic rock called sillar, giving the city its nickname. You’ll then arrive at the Andean Sanctuary Museum, where you’ll meet the famous ice mummy, Juanita, face to face. You’ll continue to the 16th century convent of Santa Catalina, which is truly a jewel of a city within a city. Finally, you’ll visit the main square of Yanahuara, with its famous panorama of Arequipa and the distant Misti Volcano.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Journey to Chivay
itinerary.subtitle: Drive through volcanic landscapes to Chivay
itinerary.description:
Today enjoy a scenic drive to the town of Chivay, your jumping-off point for the Colca Canyon. This drive goes through breathtaking landscapes and makes stops to mingle with Peru’s camelids at Pampa Cañahuas, to flock with migratory birds at Bofedales de Toccra and finally to gaze on Arequipa’s surrounding volcanoes at the outlook of Patapampa. As you look out to the snow-capped peaks of the Misti, Hualca-Hualca and Ubinas Volcanoes, breathe deeply and feel the peace of taking in something completely new!

When we arrive in Chivay, the hot springs are an excellent option for relaxation, as the locals attribute healing properties to the soothing waters

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Canyons and Condors
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring Colca Canyon and the Condor’s Cross
itinerary.description:
Early this morning, you’ll visit Condor’s Cross, where you can observe the depths of the Colca Canyon and watch the majestic flight of the giant Andean condor. You’ll also visit villages in the Colca Valley, where you’ll revel in the colorful local dress and friendly faces!

Upon conclusion of your guided tour of the Colca Canyon, you’ll return to your relaxing hotel to spend an afternoon at leisure in this beautiful part of the world!

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Relaxation and the Road to Puno
itinerary.subtitle: Drive through the altiplano to Lake Titicaca
itinerary.description:
This morning you will be able to enjoy the luxury of your hotel and spend the remaining hours reflecting on your time in the Colca Canyon.

In the afternoon you’ll depart Chivay with your private driver. The five-hour drive to Puno is through such beautiful country, the time will pass like nothing!

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Lake Titicaca’s Magical Islands
itinerary.subtitle: Full day visit to Lake Titicaca, and the islands of Uros and Taquile
itinerary.description:
Today, you will visit Lake Titicaca’s islands via private boat. Lake Titicaca, at 12,500 ft. above sea level, is the world’s highest navigable lake. This means that even when the strong Andean sun shines, the wind can be chilly, so be sure to dress warmly with layers!

Your boat will take you out through the bay of Puno, past banks of reeds to the incredible floating islands of Uros. For hundreds of years, local people have constructed these small islands by hand from the native totora reeds, continually refreshing the island floor. You will also see houses and boats cleverly constructed of reeds and a few solar panels providing illumination!

You will next motor to the island of Taquile. Outside the Bay of Puno, Taquile seems almost Mediterranean, with grassy cliffs falling toward the blue water. The residents of the island are incredibly friendly and are world-famous for being true masters of intricate knitting and weaving patterns!

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Over the Altiplano to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Titicaca Train from Puno to Cusco
itinerary.description:
This morning you will board the luxury Peru Rail Titicaca Train to Cusco. Travel in style through the Andes Mountains and the Peruvian Altiplano!

As you pull out from Puno, watch the landscape change from expansive high plains to the bustle and cement of the city. Enjoy a fine lunch, live entertainment, and an open-air observatory car during this full-day train ride.

Upon arrival, we will pick you up at the Cusco train station and bring you to your hotel in the historic center.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Visit the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Agriculture of the Andes in the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
This morning, we will take you to visit our friends in a small village and glimpse the promising future that awaits the rural Sacred Valley. Surrounded by towering mountains and hugging the shore of the breathtakingly blue Lake Piuray, agriculture dominates life in this close-knit place. The women of the village are weaving masters that use Incan techniques, materials, and patterns, and have formed a weaving association providing community development through sales and teachings.

Next, you’ll embark on a unique culinary adventure with Manuel Choque, a visionary farmer who has revolutionized the cultivation of Andean potatoes. On his farm, you will not only see potatoes in surprising colors and shapes, but you will learn about their ancestral value and how Manuel has reinvented these tubers to turn them into superfoods of the future. From potato tastings to innovative liquors, this experience is a feast of Andean flavors and knowledge that will make you see the potato like never before.

At the end of your delicious farm-to-table lunch, we will bring you to your hotel in the Sacred Valley for an afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - The Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Andean Traditions and Horseback Riding through the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
Today we enjoy a special day, visiting several treasures of the Sacred Valley of the Incas, off-the beaten path, and away from the crowds.

This morning, you will get your hands dirty and learn all about the building traditions of the Sacred Valley. Surrounded by colorful mountains, hummingbirds, and horses, our local experts in traditional mud brick making will share their first-hand knowledge about this building tradition. With their help, you’ll make some strong mud mix yourself and shape it into blocks.

You will then enjoy a lunch of tasty and colorful Peruvian flavors, descending from diverse cultures.

This afternoon, you will enjoy a day of easy horseback riding along the footsteps of the Incas atop the famous Peruvian Paso horses. We will spend approximately 3 ½ hours riding through the mountains, visiting the Maras salt mines, the quaint, colonial village of Maras, and the archeological site of Moray, an agricultural experimentation and development center of the Incas.

From here we begin our return to the ranch, descending through large expanses of farmland, with spectacular views of the mountains and fields. This part of the ride is a beautiful mix of peaceful landscapes and adventurous riding, perfect for all experience levels.

Upon completion of your tour, your private transport will bring you to your hotel in Cusco.

itinerary.title: DAY 11 - Delving Into the Heart of the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring Ollantaytambo and train to Aguas Calientes
itinerary.description:
Today, we will take you to the ancient town of Ollantaytambo, one of the few remaining places in Peru that retains its original Incan urban planning. You’ll note still-functioning street canals, multi-family houses with secret interior courtyards and iconic Incan trapezoidal doors! Here we’ll visit the Incan fortress perched on the mountainside overlooking the sleepy pueblo, and learn about nearby stone quarries and the pivotal Incan battle fought here.

We hope you worked up an appetite this morning, because next on the schedule is a true Peruvian feast: the traditional Pachamanca! The centuries-old Pachamanca tradition involves marinating lamb, pork, chicken, and potatoes in a variety of Andean ingredients and cooking them to perfection in an underground oven.

This afternoon, we’ll make our way to the train station in Ollantaytambo, where we’ll board the first-class Vistadome train to Aguas Calientes. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows!

itinerary.title: DAY 12 - Private tour of Machu Picchu
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu
itinerary.description:
This is your day to enjoy a private tour of Machu Picchu. In the morning after breakfast in your hotel, you and your guide will board the bus to the entrance of the ruins. You will then ascend stone steps, through heavy tree cover to finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu! Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city, introducing you to the history of this spectacular citadel and showing you the most important temples and ceremonial sites.

After completing your Machu Picchu visit you will descend to Aguas Calientes for lunch and your return Vistadome train. We will be waiting to collect you in the Ollantaytambo train station and will bring you to your hotel in Cusco for the evening.

itinerary.title: DAY 13 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring the Imperial City of Cusco and the Stars Above
itinerary.description:
This morning you’ll enjoy Cusco’s rich tapestry woven by its inviting cobblestone streets, charming neighborhoods, and astounding landmarks.

You’ll explore some of Cusco’s most famous sites, including the imposing fortress of Sacsayhuaman, the Temple of the Sun – Qoricancha, which was once bathed in pure cold, as well as the 12-angled-stone nestled within a wall that has stood the true test of time… and many earthquakes!

This evening, we will take you up into the hills near Sacsayhuaman, away from the city lights for a guided visit to Cusco’s one-of-a-kind planetarium. Learn about Andean astronomy and Incan astrology from a short video presentation projected onto a domed theatre and then look to the stars!

Enjoy time with your excellent guide as you use telescopes to search for the famous Southern Cross and Andean constellations.

After your Planetarium visit, we will bring you back to your hotel where you can enjoy the rest of the evening.

itinerary.title: DAY 14 - Bidding Farewell to Peru
itinerary.subtitle: Morning food tour before you head home
itinerary.description:
This morning, eat your way through the streets during your last morning here! Explore the vibrant San Pedro Market and the charming side streets while visiting some of the best food stalls in Cusco, where you'll get to taste some delicious local specialties from tamales to cherimoya!

At the appropriate time this afternoon, we will escort you to the Cusco airport for your return flight to Lima. Watch the windows as the snow-capped peaks of the Andes become coastal desert. We will help you check in for your international flight and wish you buen viaje!
