title: Peru Honeymoon
tagline: Una escapada íntima y exclusiva entre suites palaciegas, trenes de lujo y lagos sagrados.
overview:
Peru is a country brimming with romantic sentiment—musically, gastronomically, and geographically. The Andes region, from sacred Incan towns like Ollantaytambo to the famed Machu Picchu, offers an idyllic setting for an unforgettable Peru honeymoon.

Peruvian dishes like ceviche or lomo saltado marry fresh, local ingredients to create culinary masterpieces. The diverse landscapes range from sun-kissed coastlines to dramatic mountain vistas. This exclusive itinerary, perfect for a Peru honeymoon or a romantic getaway, takes you through the country’s most enchanting venues, exploring its sights, sounds, and flavors. Are you ready to fall in love all over again?
inclusions: Personalized itinerary planning
An Unu Raymi host to assist you in every location
The majority of meals in the itinerary
Daily activities and excursions as indicated in the itinerary
exclusions: International flights to and from your home country

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Arrive at your hotel in Lima after your international flight to Peru!
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival to Lima, you’ll find your Unu Raymi host ready to take you directly to your hotel where you can relax into the evening and enjoy a good night’s rest before embarking on the next day’s adventure.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Culinary exploration in the City of Kings
itinerary.description:
Wake up refreshed and enjoy breakfast at your hotel this morning. You have the morning to spend at your leisure, whether enjoying the comforts of your hotel or exploring vibrant Miraflores!

In the late afternoon you will be taken to an award-winning culinary route. In addition to seeing several cultural highlights of Lima and sampling delicacies from world-renowned restaurants, you'll enjoy a beachfront pisco sour demonstration, learn how to make your own citrus ceviche, and taste fruits straight from the Amazon.

As your culinary tour progresses, you will dine at Huaca Pucllana, one of the best-known gourmet restaurants in Lima. Located In the heart of Miraflores, this unique restaurant has views of a “huaca” or pre-Columbian pyramidal temple. which at night is spectacularly illuminated. Finally, continue towards the bohemian districts of Barranco. Walk the traditional Bridge of Sighs, a must-see for lovers. The icing on the cake will be a sample of traditional desserts.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Lima to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Cusco and visit the Sulca Textile Museum in Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, we’ll escort you back to the airport for your morning flight to Cusco in the morning. Watch the windows as the desert coast rises into the snow-capped peaks of the Andes!

Upon touching down in Cusco, we’ll take you to the historic center for a tasty lunch, before taking you to the Sacred Valley, where the lower altitudes make it easier to acclimatize.

Just 15 minutes outside of Cusco, true Peruvian countryside will stretch away on either side of you as impossibly steep peaks rise in the distance. Our first stop is at Sulca Textile Museum. where you’ll see traditional weavers ply their trade and get to meet Peru’s famous llamas and alpacas face to face!

After your visit, we will take you to your hotel in the heart of the Sacred Valley for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Tour a local hacienda and explore the agricultural site of Pisac
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, your journey will take you to an old hacienda, nestled in the fertile valley next to the pueblo of Pisac. Step onto the family-owned hacienda grounds and step into centuries past while your hosts expound upon the growing process of Giant White Corn and its profound cultural significance in the Andes Mountains. This hacienda dates back generations, and you’ll immediately be immersed in local customs steeped in the spirits and mysticism of the Andes, embraced by the warmth of local Peruvians.

Relish your time on the farm with a delicious multi-course lunch with sample dishes featuring none other than the “white gold” giant-kernelled corn, and make sure to visit the on-site stables housing the renowned Peruvian Paso horses. Watch the horses dance with their human counterparts in a “marinera” demonstration and even go for a quick trot yourself if you feel up to the task!

From here, continue up the mountain in your private vehicle for today’s final stop at the ruins overlooking Pisac. Here, you’ll learn about the complexity of the Incan agricultural system, and their methods of cultivating thousands of varieties of corn and potatoes, and you’ll watch the sun sink over the tips of the Andes Mountains surrounding you.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Wed with Andean Spirits as Your Witness
itinerary.subtitle: Celebrate traditional wedding ceremony and offering to Pachamama (Mother Earth)!
itinerary.description:
Performed by an Andean shaman amidst the splendor of Peru’s sierra, and in the presence of the Apus (mountain spirits) and Pachamama (Mother Earth), an Andean wedding ceremony is an incredibly mystical and meaningful way for a couple to bind their lives together or renew their vows to one another.

The ceremony begins in the morning and will include rites of purification and flowering, as well as rites of the four elements – water (purity), fire (strength), air (the Apus), and earth (Pachamama). Together with the help of your shaman, you will make an offering to Pachamama, asking that she protect your union, before exchanging symbolic presents and drink to ensure the strength of your union.

After the ceremony, enjoy a delicious lunch of local flavors before heading back to your hotel for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Morning train through the cloud forest and visit the Machu Picchu Citadel
itinerary.description:
In the morning, we will board the train in Ollantaytambo for our journey to Machu Picchu. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows! Upon arrival at Aguas Calientes, we’ll tuck into an early lunch in order to refuel before ascending to Peru’s lost citadel.

After a bus ride to the gates of this wonder of the world, you will pass through the main gates with your private guide to finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu. The incredible Inca stone construction will be spread below, alternately hidden and revealed by clouds. Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city.

Upon conclusion of your tour, return for an evening in Aguas Calientes. Enjoy an excellent dinner on-site at your hotel and fall into bed, lulled to sleep by the sound of the cloud forest around you.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Second visit to Machu Picchu and hike to the top
itinerary.description:
Today you have the option to hike two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you how you would like to culminate your Machu Picchu luxury tour. Feeling adventurous? Consider hiking the steep slope of neighboring Huayna Picchu or the less steep but taller Machu Picchu Mountain, both of which offer unrivaled views over Machu Picchu. Please note that only a limited number of hikers are allowed to climb Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain each day and tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

In the afternoon, reconvene in Aguas Calientes and board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and bring you to your hotel for a well-deserved good night’s rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Private tour of Ollantaytambo and enjoy a traditional Pachamanca feast
itinerary.description:
Today, we will take you to the ancient town of Ollantaytambo, one of the few remaining places in Peru that retains its original Incan urban planning. You’ll note still-functioning street canals, multi-family houses with secret interior courtyards and iconic Incan trapezoidal doors! Here we’ll visit the Incan fortress perched on the mountainside overlooking the sleepy pueblo and learn about nearby stone quarries and the pivotal Incan battle fought here.

We hope you worked up an appetite this morning, because next on the schedule is a true Peruvian feast: the traditional Pachamanca! The centuries-old Pachamanca tradition involves marinating lamb, pork, chicken, and potatoes in a variety of Andean ingredients and cooking them to perfection in an underground oven. You’ll witness each step of the process: how the oven is prepared, how white-hot stones are layered, and how the feast materializes before your eyes!

While waiting for your feast to roast, make sure to wander through the grounds’ organic garden, smell the fresh-roasted coffee produced by the farm’s head roaster, and sample some of the varieties of cañazo (a local Andean spirit) that are produced on-site at the one-of-a-kind distillery.

Upon completion of your meal, we will take you to your hotel in Cusco for an afternoon spent at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Cusco
itinerary.description:
Explore the hidden cobblestone streets of historical Cusco

It’s time to get acquainted with Cusco, a romantic city that wins the heart of almost every traveler that passes through it. After breakfast, meet your guide and wander among the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuaman, where the Incas staged a great battle against the conquistadors. Return to the city and roam the atmospheric streets of the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, which is known for its free-spirited scene. Explore Coricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery (a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun); see where the locals make their grocery runs at the open-air San Pedro market and pass the famous 12-angled stone, whose image appears on the bottle of the local Cusqueña beer.

At the end of the tour, your guide will suggest places to enjoy a delicious local lunch. Then this afternoon, explore the Inca capital on your own terms.

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - Towards Idyllic Beaches
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Tumbes and settle into your beachside resort
itinerary.description:
From the mountains to the coastline, Peru is ready to offer you something spectacular.

Early this morning we will pick you up from your Cusco hotel to continue your romantic encounter or Peru honeymoon on Peru’s northern beaches. We will send you on your way to Tumbes in the north of Peru via a connecting flight to Lima.

A host from your beachside resort will be waiting to meet you at the airport in Tumbes, ready to accompany you on a breathtaking coastal road trip to Mancora.

Check in to your beautiful hotel and instantly begin enjoying its comforts on this simply lovely stretch of coast.

itinerary.title: DAY 11 - Beachside Paradise
itinerary.subtitle: Spend the day soaking in the serenity of this tranquil corner of Peru
itinerary.description: Spend the day reveling in the luxury and tranquility of your hotel and enjoying these wonderful beaches. Relax, take a surf lesson, or ask your hotel about sites of interest and places to visit whilst you are here.

itinerary.title: DAY 12 - Beachside Paradise
itinerary.subtitle: A second day of tranquility
itinerary.description:
One more beach day on your romantic journey through Peru? Yes, please. Enjoy a day of leisure, with activities like snorkeling in the lively Organos Bay, and discover its unique marine wonder world, including a coral reef and its colorful inhabitants. This beautiful bay is an ideal spot to enjoy snorkeling, an activity suitable for almost every level of expertise.

If it is your first time snorkeling, you will be given some basic techniques so that you will be able to learn all you need in just one day. The only requirement is to know how to swim!

itinerary.title: DAY 13 - Tumbes to Lima to Home
itinerary.subtitle: Bidding farewell to Peru
itinerary.description:
After nearly two weeks of unforgettable memories made in Peru, it's time to depart home. First, we’ll bring you to Tumbes airport for your return flight to Lima. In Lima, an Unu Raymi host will meet you and take you to a restaurant in Costa del Sol before returning to the airport for your journey home! Buen viaje!

Intimate, personalized, and a romantic experience all around, this Andean getaway makes for the perfect honeymoon in Peru. Get in touch with Unu Raymi and we’ll start crafting your very own customized private travel experience to Peru just for the two of you!

Instead of navigating a new city after a long flight, let us take care of the transportation logistics. We will drop you off at your hotel so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before the real excursion starts. Relax with a good night’s rest before the adventure begins.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Discover the City of Kings
itinerary.description:
After a refreshing sleep, enjoy a comfortable breakfast in your hotel. The morning is yours to enjoy, taking advantage of the comforts of your hotel or exploring vibrant Miraflores.

An Unu Raymi host will collect you at the appropriate time and bring you to the Pueblo Libre neighborhood, home to the Larco Herrera Museum. Housing the country’s largest collection of pre-Columbian artifacts, gold and silver collections, as well as the infamous erotic archaeological collection, this museum is a unique experience. You’ll even have rare open access to their exquisitely cataloged storage area. Start with a delicious lunch lounging on the vine-covered terrace of the Museum’s café before exploring the exhibits.

Once your museum tour is over, it’s time to wander the “City of Kings,” where you’ll visit the Plaza Mayor, the Convent of San Francisco, and the Casa Aliaga, which is the western hemisphere’s oldest mansion and still owned and inhabited by the 17th generation of the Aliaga family. There are so many surprising secrets to learn around the city, like finding out where the subterranean catacombs are hidden.

Upon completion of your tour, you’ll be guided back to the hotel and we will provide a few suggestions for dinner and entertainment within walking distance of Miraflores.

itinerary.subtitle: Hike through the Patacancha Valley and enjoy a Pachamanca Feast

This is the spot where the Incas secured an important victory over the Spanish conquistadors. Inspect the intricately hewn stone constructions and have your guide show you the distant quarries from which the Incas sourced their materials. itinerary.title: DAY 5 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Morning train through the cloud forest on your way to visit Machu Picchu!
itinerary.description:
This is the moment all Peruvian explorers wait for. Board the luxurious Hiram Bingham train to begin your Machu Picchu journey. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows and see if you can spot some alpacas grazing in the valley! When you arrive in Aguas Calientes, enjoy an early lunch before ascending to the lost Incan citadel.

After a brief bus ride to the gates of South America’s most notable wonder, you will finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu. The incredible Inca stone citadel will reveal itself to you as you enter the main gates, a city intertwined with the clouds. Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city.

Upon conclusion of your tour, return to your hotel for the evening, and enjoy a satisfying dinner onsite before falling asleep to the sounds of the humming cloud forest around you.

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on an exclusive trek up to the top of Machu Picchu

Today you have the option to hike two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you! This will be the culmination of your Machu Picchu luxury tour, so enjoy it however you want. Adventurous travelers who desire something off-the-beaten-path should hike the steep slope of Huayna Picchu, offering unrivaled views of Machu Picchu. Please note that only a limited number of hikers are allowed to climb Huayna Picchu each day and tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

In the afternoon, descend to Aguas Calientes for your return trip on the Hiram Bingham train. You’ll enjoy a serene ride through the valley, a delicious dinner, and live music from local Andean performers.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the Inca Capital and its culinary delights
itinerary.description:
Uncover the secrets of Cusco’s cobblestone streets and taste your wait through authentic Peruvian products.

Prepare to fall in love with Cusco, a gorgeous city that wins the heart of almost every traveler that passes through it. A private tour is the best way to learn about this historic city, and get the best insider secrets! After breakfast, meet your guide and wander among the archaeological remains of Sacsayhuaman, where the Incas staged a great battle against the conquistadors. Return to the city and venture through the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, a hub of artistic inspiration. Explore Qoricancha and the Santo Domingo monastery, a colonial structure built on top of the ancient Inca temple of the sun. Live like a local and grab some groceries in the open-air San Pedro market for a delightful shopping experience!

At the end of the tour, your guide will suggest a few places to enjoy a delicious lunch, but be sure to save some room!

In the early afternoon, continue with your Peru culinary tour by heading to one of Cusco’s best restaurants and spending the afternoon learning about Peru’s culinary history and current cuisine from one of the best area chefs. You will learn how to make Peruvian starters and entrees, accompanied by a never-ending stream of snacks and samples fresh from the restaurant’s oven. Delight your palate with exotic fruits, make Pisco-based cocktails, learn a traditional way to slice vegetables, and spend the afternoon laughing and enjoying this truly special cooking class.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Visit the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Agriculture of the Andes in the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
This morning, we will take you to visit our friends in a small village and glimpse the promising future that awaits the rural Sacred Valley. Surrounded by towering mountains and hugging the shore of the breathtakingly blue Lake Piuray, agriculture dominates life in this close-knit place. The women of the village are weaving masters that use Incan techniques, materials, and patterns, and have formed a weaving association providing community development through sales and teachings.

Next, you’ll embark on a unique culinary adventure with Manuel Choque, a visionary farmer who has revolutionized the cultivation of Andean potatoes. On his farm, you will not only see potatoes in surprising colors and shapes, but you will learn about their ancestral value and how Manuel has reinvented these tubers to turn them into superfoods of the future. From potato tastings to innovative liquors, this experience is a feast of Andean flavors and knowledge that will make you see the potato like never before.

At the end of your delicious farm-to-table lunch, we will bring you to your hotel in Cusco for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Bidding Farewell to Peru!
itinerary.subtitle: Unique food tour before your flight to Lima for your international flight home
itinerary.description:
This morning, eat your way through the streets during your last morning here! Explore the vibrant San Pedro Market and the charming side streets while visiting some of the best food stalls in Cusco, where you'll get to taste some delicious local specialties from chicha de quinoa to cherimoya!

At the appropriate time this afternoon, we will escort you to the Cusco airport for your return flight to Lima. Watch the windows as the snow-capped peaks of the Andes become coastal desert. We will help you check in for your international flight and wish you buen viaje!

title: Discover Southern Peru
tagline: La gran ruta del sur: Lima, Arequipa, Cañón del Colca, Lago Titicaca, Cusco y Machu Picchu.
overview:
Explore the fascinating history and vibrant scenery of southern Peru with this expertly crafted Peru itinerary, a destination unlike any other. Savor authentic cuisine, uncover ancient Incan citadels, take in postcard-worthy landscapes, and embark on one of the world’s most iconic bucket list experiences.

Lima, Arequipa, Colca Canyon, Lake Titicaca, Cusco, Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, Maras, Moray

This unforgettable Peru itinerary begins in Arequipa, where you’ll delve into Peru’s colonial history. Next, immerse yourself in the natural wonders of Colca Canyon, home to hot springs and abundant wildlife. Sail across Lake Titicaca, the world’s highest navigable lake, before trekking through Cusco and the Sacred Valley, the heart of the Incan Empire. The grand finale is a two-day exploration of Machu Picchu, South America’s most legendary ancient site.
inclusions: Personalized itinerary planning

The majority of meals in the itinerary

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Lima
itinerary.subtitle: Arrive at your hotel in Lima after your flight to Peru!
itinerary.description: When your flight arrives in Lima, an Unu Raymi host will welcome you personally and escort you to the hotel. Instead of navigating a new city after a long flight, let us take care of the transportation logistics. We will drop you off at your hotel so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before the tour of Southern Peru begins. Relax with a good night’s rest before your flight to Arequipa in the morning.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Lima to Arequipa
itinerary.subtitle: Fly to Arequipa and relish a private tour of Peru’s second-largest city.
itinerary.description:
In the morning, you will be escorted to the airport for your flight to Arequipa. Often called “The White City,” Arequipa is famous for its dreamy colonial-era buildings, crafted from a pearly volcanic rock known as sillar. One of our hosts will help you travel to your hotel to settle in.

During the afternoon, venture out on a private city tour of Arequipa’s most intriguing sights. Capture enviable pictures of the beautiful colonial architecture, and learn about the mummy of Juanita, the preserved body of a young Inca girl found atop a glacier who was sacrificed in an ancient ritual. You will also explore a 16th-century convent before concluding your tour in the main square, Yanahuara, which boasts stunning panoramas of the city and the volcanic peak of El Misti.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Arequipa and Colca Canyon
itinerary.subtitle: Drive to the deepest Canyon in the world, spying some adorable new friends on the way!
itinerary.description:
Set off with your guide to the small town of Chivay. En route, you’ll stop at Pampa Cañahuas – a reserve inhabited by llamas and other South American camelids. Say hello before wandering to the volcano overlook, Patapampa, where you can gaze over the mighty line-up of snow-capped volcanic peaks.

After checking into your luxury hotel, it’s time to relax and enjoy the beautiful and serene surroundings. Travelers staying at Colca Lodge will be able to unwind in the restorative waters of the lodge’s natural spring pools.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Colca Canyon
itinerary.subtitle: Indulge in a day of wellness in Colca Canyon.
itinerary.description: Every traveler deserves the luxury of leisure, and Colca Canyon is the best destination to take advantage of slow, relaxing experiences. Visit one of the many hot springs in the region, soaking in the banks of the River Colca. These warm pools are fed by natural springs that produce water at temperatures of up to 80ºC. They are rich in minerals known to promote calmness and relaxation.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Condor's Cross and the Road to Puno
itinerary.subtitle: Explore the wild side of Colca Canyon; then take a private drive to Puno and Lake Titicaca.
itinerary.description:
Following breakfast at your luxury hotel, head for Condor’s Cross to peer down into the seemingly endless depths of Colca Canyon. This giant Andean fissure is one of the world’s deepest canyons, plummeting deep toward the Earth’s core. While here, see if you can spot some majestic Andean condors. This bird is frequently spotted soaring above the canyon’s abyss. After your morning in the wild, we’ll visit some of the settlements in and around Colca Valley to learn about local customs.

During the afternoon, you will enjoy views of the picturesque countryside during the five-hour journey to Puno. This private car ride is an excellent time to sit back and relax. When you arrive in Puno, your Unu Raymi host will check you into your hotel for an evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Puno and Lake Titicaca
itinerary.subtitle: Explore a private tour learning about life on Lake Titicaca.
itinerary.description:
Today, you’ll enjoy a guided private tour – which can be customized to suit those on family tours to Peru – around Lake Titicaca. Travel by boat to the floating islands of Uros, home to an ancient community whose lineage stretches back to pre-Inca times. Learn how the Uros people have managed to preserve their unique way of life through innovative and artistic daily routines that help sustain this one-of-a-kind community.

Next, sail out to Taquile Island, whose residents are honored by UNESCO for their artisanal weaving skills. Eat a lunch prepared by the hospitable islanders, before returning to your hotel in Puno.

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Over the Altiplano to Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Take the scenic route from Puno to Cusco for some unique sightseeing.
itinerary.description:
After breakfast, settle in on a guided private transfer and tour that will take you from Puno to Cusco. Along the way, you will stop at several intriguing destinations that make the drive even more exciting. The first stop comes at the Pre-Inca Pukara archaeological site. Next up: La Raya, which is at around 14,220 feet, will be the literal high point of your travels. A stunning panoramic sight full of glorious glacier-capped peaks looms in the background. In the foreground, local craftsmen sell their wares in roadside stalls.

After a peaceful lunch en route, you’ll stretch your legs once more at Raqchi. The Inca ruins here stand apart from all the rest. This town once provided rest along the Inca trail and possesses unusual stone-and-mud-brick walls, designed to ward off invaders from the south.

The penultimate destination on your guided bus tour will be the church of Andahuaylillas. Whitewashed on the outside, this church’s seemingly humble exterior veils the extravagance that lies inside. The interior’s lavish frescoes, dazzling gold leaf, and eye-popping wood sculpture have earned it the title of the “Sistine Chapel of the Americas.”

Upon arrival in Cusco, we will bring you straight to your hotel where you can rest and relax after your long journey.

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Cusco
itinerary.subtitle: Uncover the secrets of Cusco past and present .
itinerary.description:
After breakfast your private guide will proceed to illuminate Cusco’s rich tapestry woven by its inviting cobblestone streets, charming neighborhoods, and astounding landmarks.

You’ll begin with vehicle, chauffered to the Sacsayhuaman Incan ruins above the city, then you’ll set off on foot to experience the lay of the land just outside of Cusco’s city center with a light hike to the Inkilltambo archaeological site and Temple of the Moon.

On this hike of just a couple hours, you will walk through lush and fragrant eucalyptus forests, until reaching the Inkilltambo ruins with views of the Ausangate mountain in the distance.

Then, you will continue on this original Inca pathway to Temple of the Moon and enjoy a delicious outdoor lunch of local flavors in this beautiful setting before making your way back into the city through the bohemian neighborhood of San Blas, known for its whitewashed adobe buildings and quaint blue balconies, home to generations of renowned Cusco artisans.

From there you’ll stop in at the colonial Cathedral in the Plaza de Armas, then down to the Santo Domingo monastery, perched atop the most sacred of Incan sites, the Qoricancha temple of the sun. Once bathed in 24-karat gold long-since pilfered by Spanish conquistadors, this temple is now an astounding blend of Incan stonemasonry and colonial architecture.

Make sure to pause along the way to marvel at the incomparable Incan foundations supporting each building in the area, especially the 12-angled stone nestled in a wall that has withstood the test of time (as well as a couple of earth-shattering earthquakes!).

Before leaving you at your hotel, your guide will provide suggestions for fantastic dining in the city.

itinerary.title: DAY 9 - Exploring the Sacred Valley
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring the Agricultural Diversity of the Sacred Valley
itinerary.description:
Today you will weave through the Sacred Valley’s most fertile agricultural lands and experience an unforgettable blend of the past, present, and future. We will take you to visit our friends in a small village and glimpse the promising future that awaits the rural Sacred Valley.

Surrounded by towering mountains and hugging the shore of the breathtakingly blue Lake Piuray, agriculture dominates life in this close-knit place. The women of the village are weaving masters that use Incan techniques, materials, and patterns, and have formed a weaving association providing community development through sales and teachings.

Next, you’ll embark on a unique culinary adventure with Manuel Choqque, a visionary farmer who has revolutionized the cultivation of Andean potatoes. On his farm, you will not only see potatoes in surprising colors and shapes, but you will learn about their ancestral value and how Manuel has reinvented these tubers to turn them into superfoods of the future. From potato tastings to innovative liquors, this experience is a feast of Andean flavors and knowledge that will make you see the potato like never before. Come and discover the taste of innovation in the Andes!

At the end of your delicious farm-to-table lunch, we will bring you to your hotel in the Sacred Valley for an afternoon at leisure.

itinerary.title: DAY 10 - The Lost City of the Incas
itinerary.subtitle: Relax with a morning train through the cloud forest on your way to visit Machu Picchu!
itinerary.description:
This is the moment all Peruvian explorers wait for. Board the train in Ollantaytambo to begin your Machu Picchu journey. Watch the cloud jungle pass by through the large glass windows, and see if you can spot some alpacas grazing in the valley! When you arrive in Aguas Calientes, enjoy an early lunch before ascending to the lost Incan citadel.

After a bus ride to the gates of South America’s most notable wonder, you will finally emerge at the top of the world – Machu Picchu. The incredible Inca stone citadel will reveal itself to you as you enter the main gates, a city intertwined with the clouds. Your expert guide will give you a private tour of the ancient city.

Upon conclusion of your tour, return for an evening in Aguas Calientes. Enjoy an excellent dinner on-site at your hotel and fall into bed, lulled to sleep by the sound of the cloud forest around you.

itinerary.title: DAY 11 - Machu Picchu on your terms
itinerary.subtitle: Embark on an exclusive trek up the highly coveted Huayna Picchu!
itinerary.description:
Today you have the option to hike two different trails – Huayna Picchu or Machu Picchu Mountain, so it’s completely up to you! This will be the culmination of your Machu Picchu luxury tour, so enjoy it however you want. Adventurous travelers who desire something off-the-beaten path should hike the steep slope of Huayna Picchu, offering unrivaled views of Machu Picchu. Please note that only a limited amount of hikers are allowed to climb Huayna Picchu each day and tickets will need to be purchased in advance along with your Machu Picchu entrance.

In the afternoon, reconvene in Aguas Calientes and board the return train to Ollantaytambo. Your Unu Raymi host will meet you at the station and bring you to your hotel in the Sacred Valley for a well-earned evening of rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 12 - Maras and Moray
itinerary.subtitle: Learn to make Chicha before Exploring Maras and Moray on Horseback
itinerary.description:
Today we enjoy a special day, visiting several treasures of the Sacred Valley of the Incas, off-the beaten path, and away from the crowds.

Surrounded by colourful mountains, hummingbirds, and horses, you will learn and participate hands on how to make chicha de jora, the traditional drink of the Incas – a type of delicious and refreshing corn beer. You will also experience the ritual ceremonies that take place when drinking chicha.

You will then enjoy a lunch of tasty and colorful Peruvian flavors, descending from diverse cultures.

This afternoon, you will enjoy a day of easy horseback riding along the footsteps of the Incas atop the famous Peruvian Paso horses. We will spend approximately 3 ½ hours riding through the mountains, visiting the Maras salt mines, the quaint, colonial village of Maras, and the archeological site of Moray, an agricultural experimentation and development center of the Incas.

From here we begin our return to the ranch, descending through large expanses of farmland, with spectacular views of the mountains and fields. This part of the ride is a beautiful mix of peaceful landscapes and adventurous riding, perfect for all experience levels.

Upon completion of your tour, your private transport will bring you to your hotel in Cusco.

itinerary.title: DAY 13 - Cusco to Lima and Home
itinerary.subtitle: Tour the bohemian streets of Barranco and bid farewell to Peru
itinerary.description:
Going home is the worst part of any private Peru vacation, but at Unu Raymi, we’ll do our best to make it as smooth and hassle-free as possible. First, we’ll take you to Cusco airport for your return flight to Lima. In Lima, an Unu Raymi host will meet you and take you to the seaside bohemian district of Barranco. See the streets of Barranco come alive as you visit a number of local art galleries and shops that support local artisans.

Finally, enjoy a first-class gourmet meal featuring world-renowned Peruvian flavors in a restaurant of your choice before returning to the airport for your journey home! Buen Viaje!

Discover the alluring town of Valparaíso as you stroll through bohemian neighborhoods decorating Chile’s Pacific coast. This picturesque city was declared World Heritage by UNESCO thanks to its quirky features and historic landmarks.

On the way to Valparaiso, we’ll make a stop in the Casablanca Valley to learn about the local winemaking process of cool coastal white varieties like Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc. After a delectable tasting, you’ll get to wander Valparaíso and stroll through Viña del Mar, a paradise frozen in time.

itinerary.subtitle: Travel to San Pedro de Atacama

itinerary.description:
This morning we will escort you to the airport for your flight to Chile’s rugged desert region. At the appropriate time, you will be transferred to the airport for a short flight to the little town of San Pedro de Atacama.

This small town is in the driest desert in the world. Appreciate the little adobe houses and cozy restaurants throughout the city that provide a relaxing base for travelers exploring one of Chile’s most spectacular sceneries.

itinerary.title: DAY 1 - Arrival in Chile
itinerary.subtitle: Welcome to Chile!
itinerary.description: When your flight arrives in Chile’s capital of Santiago, an Unu Raymi host will welcome you personally and escort you to the hotel. We will drop you off so you can refresh and enjoy a peaceful evening before your adventurous journey begins. Relax with a good night’s rest.

itinerary.title: DAY 2 - Santiago
itinerary.subtitle: Exploring the capital of Chile
itinerary.description: Explore the city of Santiago de Chile, taking in the Plaza de Armas, the Hidalgo castle, and the current government headquarters – La Moneda. Other stops include the Metropolitan Cathedral, the palace of the Royal High Court, and the Central Market. In the Bellavista neighborhood, you’ll find “La Chascona” one of the three residences of the famous Chilean poet Pablo Neruda. Then, journey to San Cristobal Hill where you can ride the “teleférico” and enjoy a marvelous panoramic view of the whole city.

itinerary.title: DAY 3 - Valparaíso
itinerary.subtitle: Valparaíso / Viña del Mar
itinerary.description:
Discover the alluring town of Valparaíso as you stroll through bohemian neighborhoods decorating Chile’s Pacific coast. This picturesque city was declared World Heritage by UNESCO thanks to its quirky features and historical landmarks.

After wandering the Plaza Victoria, covered in Peruvian sculptures, we’ll explore downtown and Plaza Sotomayor before reaching the Prat port. Relax with the first gondola ride of the day as you head to the beautiful Palacio Baburizza, constructed in 1916. Pass by the colorful houses that stare down from above the city and the bay with a peaceful afternoon in this unique coastal destination.

itinerary.title: DAY 4 - Torres del Paine
itinerary.subtitle: Flight to Punta Arenas
itinerary.description:
Today, you’ll fly to Torres del Paine National Park, one of the most famous natural preserves in the world. We’ll pick you up from your hotel and drive you to the airport for the short flight to Punta Arenas. Once you land, we’ll escort you directly to Las Torres Hotel located inside Torres del Paine National Park.

When you arrive, your hosts will talk about what activities are available for you over the next few days. If you landed in Torres del Paine early in the day, you may be able to try a half-day adventure like rock climbing, trekking through the lenga forest, or visiting the organic garden.

itinerary.title: DAY 5 - Torres del Paine
itinerary.subtitle: Trekking to Base Torres Viewpoint
itinerary.description:
Make sure to enjoy a hearty breakfast before getting ready to hike to the park’s main trail to an infamous viewpoint where you can observe the slender, granite peaks that give the national park its name.

The trek winds through Ascencio Valley, crosses a beautiful forest of Lengas, and travels through to a rocky area known as La Morrena, the most difficult section of the trail, before finishing at the spectacular Torres Base Viewpoint. Take a deep breath while you enjoy the amazing scenery from here while snapping a few photos, before returning along the same trail.

Duration: Eight hours

Difficulty level: High

itinerary.title: DAY 6 - Torres del Paine
itinerary.subtitle: Hike to Los Cuernos
itinerary.description:
Today’s trek begins at the Inge Lagoon, where you’ll most likely be able to spot a few condors and other birds of prey circling the skies above you. Ascends on an impressive trail up the side of the Almirante Nieto Mountain, part of the Paine Massif. You’ll be rewarded with great views of Nordenskjöld Lake and the chance to cross over the Bader River before reaching your final destination.

After about 6 – 6.5 hours you will get to the French camp area to rest and recover before tomorrow’s challenging trek to “The French Valley.”

Difficulty level: Medium

itinerary.title: DAY 7 - Stop in Santiago
itinerary.subtitle: Trek the French Valley
itinerary.description:
A spectacular natural basin surrounded by mythic peaks and hanging glaciers. An hour-long walk across a winding path brings you to the French River. At the entrance to the French Valley, a glacial moraine, you’ll scramble over huge boulders and catch the first sight of the hanging glacier atop the valley.

From here, you’ll ascend through a dreamlike Japanese garden landscape before arriving at a viewpoint known as the “Plateau”. To one side, the French Glacier and Paine Grande; to the other, La Espada, La Hoja, La Máscara, and the main and north “horns” of Los Cuernos arch upwards. In the upper section of the Valley, Cerro Catedral and Cerro Fortaleza stand tall like an imposing presence in the distance.

Difficulty level: Moderate

itinerary.title: DAY 8 - Torres del Paine to Puerto Natales
itinerary.subtitle: Hiking to Grey Viewpoint and return to Puerto Natales
itinerary.description:
This morning you’ll exit the French sector and traverse to the south-west side of Paine Grande, Torres del Paine’s highest peak. Pass through the final leg of your journey across the native firebush and evergreen forests to the shores of Pehoe Lake. Travel by the Refugio Paine Grande before ascending 200 up the narrow, twisted path towards Laguna Los Patos. Here, you’ll see pieces of the massive Southern Patagonian Ice Field, a geological phenomenon that still hides many unclimbed mountains. Then you will be able to continue to Grey Glacier’s lookout point with possible sightings of the spectacled and flightless steamer ducks native to this region..

Difficulty level: Moderate

From Pehoé Shore you will take a short ride to the opposite side of the lake at Pudeto pier, from where your private transport will be waiting to take you to your hotel in Puerto Natales.

tagline: El encanto colonial de Bogotá y Cartagena, el aroma del Eje Cafetero y la innovación de Medellín.
overview: Una odisea privada de 10 días por el realismo mágico colombiano. Desde las calles adoquinadas de La Candelaria y los bosques de palmas de cera gigantes en Salento, hasta la vibrante transformación de Medellín y las casonas coloniales con buganvilias de Cartagena de Indias.
inclusions: Traslados ejecutivos privados y concierge personal Unu Raymi 24/7
Alojamiento 5 estrellas en Four Seasons Casa Medina (Bogotá) y Sofitel Legend Santa Clara (Cartagena)
Vuelos domésticos internos en clase preferente
Cata privada de cafés especiales de origen con barista máster en hacienda cafetera
Día completo en yate privado por las Islas del Rosario con chef a bordo
Cena degustación en Celele (The World's 50 Best) en el barrio Getsemaní

itinerary.title: Llegada a Bogotá — Capital Andina
itinerary.description: Bienvenida VIP en el aeropuerto El Dorado y traslado al histórico hotel Four Seasons Casa Medina. Cóctel de bienvenida con frutas exóticas colombianas.

itinerary.title: Museo del Oro, La Candelaria & Teleférico a Monserrate
itinerary.description: Paseo guiado por la colección prehispánica de orfebrería más grande del mundo en el Museo del Oro. Ascenso al cerro Monserrate con vista panorámica de la sabana.

itinerary.title: Vuelo al Eje Cafetero & Hacienda Tradicional
itinerary.description: Vuelo hacia Armenia/Pereira. Traslado a una hacienda cafetera privada. Paseo por los cafetales aprendiendo el proceso de recolección y tostado artesanal.

itinerary.title: Valle del Cocora: Palmas de Cera Gigantes & Salento
itinerary.description: Excursión en jeeps Willys clásicos hacia el Valle del Cocora. Caminata entre las palmas de cera más altas del mundo (árbol nacional de Colombia) y visita a Salento.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a Medellín — Ciudad de la Eterna Primavera
itinerary.description: Vuelo hacia Medellín. Traslado al hotel boutique The Charlee en El Poblado. Tarde de café y gastronomía contemporánea paisa.

itinerary.title: Innovación Urbana en Comuna 13 & Peñol de Guatapé
itinerary.description: Recorrido privado por las escaleras eléctricas y arte urbano de la Comuna 13. Visita a la gigantesca roca de El Peñol y al colorido pueblo de Guatapé.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a Cartagena de Indias — Joya del Caribe
itinerary.description: Vuelo hacia la costa caribeña. Llegada a Cartagena y traslado al convento restaurado Sofitel Legend Santa Clara. Paseo en carruaje al atardecer.

itinerary.title: Fortalezas Militares, Murallas & Calles Coloniales
itinerary.description: Exploración privada del Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas, el Palacio de la Inquisición y los balcones floridos del centro histórico amurallado.

itinerary.title: Navegación en Yate Privado por las Islas del Rosario
itinerary.description: Zarpe privado hacia las aguas turquesas del archipiélago de las Islas del Rosario. Almuerzo caribeño de langosta y tarde de playa virgen y snorkel.

itinerary.title: Despedida de Cartagena & Colombia
itinerary.description: Desayuno tropical en el claustro y traslado privado al aeropuerto internacional para su vuelo de regreso.

title: Alturas Norteñas y Terruños de Mendoza
tagline: Vinos de altura, quebradas rojizas y estancias centenarias al pie de los Andes.
subtitle: Mendoza, Cafayate, Cachi y Salta la Linda en servicio privado exclusivo
overview: Una inmersión sublime en las regiones vinícolas más prestigiosas de Argentina y los sobrecogedores paisajes de los Valles Calchaquíes. Desde catas guiadas por enólogos jefes en bodegas de diseño vanguardista en el Valle de Uco hasta travesías en 4x4 por la Quebrada de las Conchas y viñedos a más de 2,500 metros sobre el nivel del mar.
highlights: Degustaciones privadas de Malbecs de guarda y almuerzos maridados por chefs de renombre en Valle de Uco
Alojamiento exclusivo en The Vines of Mendoza Resort & Spa y estancia boutique en Cafayate
Travesía en 4x4 privado a través de la Quebrada de las Flechas y Parque Nacional Los Cardones
Cena de gala privada con maridaje de Torrontés de altura en bodega histórica de Salta

itinerary.title: Llegada a Mendoza - Valle de Uco
itinerary.description: Recepción VIP en pista del aeropuerto de Mendoza y traslado privado en SUV de lujo hacia su villa privada en el Valle de Uco. Cóctel de bienvenida con vistas panorámicas al Volcán Tupungato y cena de autor.

itinerary.title: Terruños Íconos del Valle de Uco
itinerary.description: Jornada dedicada a bodegas de renombre internacional como Zuccardi Valle de Uco y SuperUco. Encuentro exclusivo con enólogos jefes y almuerzo maridado de 6 pasos.

itinerary.title: Cabalgar al Pie de la Cordillera & Spa de Vino
itinerary.description: Mañana de cabalgata suave guiada por gauchos locales a través de los viñedos y arroyos cordilleranos. Tarde de tratamientos de vinoterapia en el spa privado.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a Salta - La Linda Colonial
itinerary.description: Traslado privado al aeropuerto y vuelo a Salta. Check-in en casona señorial neocolonial. Recorrido privado a pie por el casco histórico y Museo de Arqueología de Alta Montaña.

itinerary.title: Cuesta del Obispo & Parque Nacional Los Cardones
itinerary.description: Ascenso escénico por la Cuesta del Obispo hasta alcanzar los 3,348 msnm. Almuerzo campestre privado entre cactus centenarios y llegada a la pintoresca villa de Cachi.

itinerary.title: Quebrada de las Flechas hacia Cafayate
itinerary.description: Travesía por la legendaria Ruta 40 atravesando formaciones geológicas de otro mundo en la Quebrada de las Flechas. Arribo a Cafayate y primera cata de Torrontés.

itinerary.title: Viñedos Extremos de Altura en Cafayate
itinerary.description: Visita a viñedos situados hasta los 3,000 metros de altura en Colomé y bodega El Esteco. Visita al museo de la luz de James Turrell en Colomé.

itinerary.title: Quebrada de las Conchas & Regreso a Salta
itinerary.description: Paseo matutino por el Anfiteatro y la Garganta del Diablo en la Quebrada de las Conchas. Retorno a Salta y cena privada de despedida en peña folclórica de gala.

itinerary.title: Despedida de Salta y Conexión Internacional
itinerary.description: Desayuno con dulces caseros en los jardines de la estancia. Traslado privado con asistencia de concierge al aeropuerto de Salta para su vuelo de conexión.

included: Recepción VIP y traslados privados en SUV ejecutiva durante todo el viaje
8 noches en hoteles Relais & Châteaux y resorts vinícolas de ultra-lujo
Todas las visitas y catas privadas con sommeliers de prestigio
Almuerzos maridados y cenas gourmet detalladas en el itinerario
Guía privado de élite certificado y concierge disponible 24/7
not_included: Vuelos internacionales e internos (gestionables a solicitud)
Gastos personales, propinas y seguros médicos internacionales

practical_info.season: Octubre a Mayo (vendimia en Febrero - Abril)

ideal_for: Amantes del buen vino, parejas y viajeros sofisticados

title: Patagonia Austral: Glaciares, Lagos y Estancias
tagline: Hielos milenarios, lagos turquesa y el espíritu indómito del fin del mundo.
subtitle: Bariloche, El Calafate y Glaciar Perito Moreno con estancias privadas
overview: La inmensidad patagónica vivida con la máxima sofisticación y calidez. Navegaciones exclusivas en catamarán privado entre témpanos de hielo azul, caminata sobre el majestuoso glaciar Perito Moreno y estadías en estancias patagónicas que combinan tradición ganadera y confort de 5 estrellas.
highlights: Navegación privada por el Lago Nahuel Huapi en yate de lujo con chef a bordo
Trekking sobre el Glaciar Perito Moreno con crampones y brindis de whisky con hielo milenario
Navegación exclusiva por los canales del Lago Argentino hacia los glaciares Upsala y Spegazzini
Estancia exclusiva en Eolo Patagonia Spirit of the Place con vistas a la estepa infinita

itinerary.title: Llegada a San Carlos de Bariloche
itinerary.description: Llegada y bienvenida privada. Traslado hacia el emblemático Llao Llao Hotel & Resort. Tarde libre para disfrutar del spa y las vistas al Lago Moreno.

itinerary.title: Yate Privado por el Lago Nahuel Huapi
itinerary.description: Embarque en yate exclusivo hacia la Isla Victoria y el mágico Bosque de Arrayanes. Almuerzo preparado a bordo por chef privado con trucha patagónica y maridaje de vinos.

itinerary.title: Sabores Patagónicos & Chocolates de Bariloche
itinerary.description: Taller sensorial privado con maestro chocolatero y cata de cervezas artesanales premium. Tarde de cabalgata panorámica por el Valle del Encanto.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a El Calafate - Tierra de Glaciares
itinerary.description: Vuelo panorámico hacia El Calafate. Traslado privado a Eolo, miembro de Relais & Châteaux situado en una estancia de 4,000 hectáreas con vistas al Lago Argentino.
itinerary.accommodation: Eolo Patagonia Spirit of the Place

itinerary.title: Minitrekking Exclusivo en Glaciar Perito Moreno
itinerary.description: Acceso preferencial antes de las multitudes a las pasarelas del Perito Moreno. Caminata sobre los hielos con guías expertos y brindis con whisky sobre el glaciar.
itinerary.accommodation: Eolo Patagonia Spirit of the Place

itinerary.title: Crucero Glaciares Gourmet: Upsala & Spegazzini
itinerary.description: Embarque en el salón VIP del crucero María Turquesa para navegar entre témpanos monumentales y contemplar la pared de hielo del Glaciar Spegazzini de 135 m de alto.
itinerary.accommodation: Eolo Patagonia Spirit of the Place

itinerary.title: Vida de Estancia & Día de Aventura en Estepa
itinerary.description: Día en estancia patagónica tradicional: demostración de esquila de ovejas, asado de cordero patagónico al asador y caminata de avistamiento de cóndores andinos.
itinerary.accommodation: Eolo Patagonia Spirit of the Place

itinerary.title: Vuelo al Fin del Mundo: Ushuaia
itinerary.description: Vuelo hacia la ciudad más austral del planeta. Check-in en Arakur Ushuaia Resort & Spa ubicado dentro de la Reserva Natural Cerro Alarkén.

itinerary.title: Navegación Canal Beagle & Parque Nacional Tierra del Fuego
itinerary.description: Navegación privada por el mítico Canal Beagle bordeando el Faro Les Eclaireurs y colonias de lobos marinos. Almuerzo en refugio exclusivo en Bahía Lapataia.

itinerary.title: Despedida de Tierra del Fuego
itinerary.description: Mañana relajante en las piscinas infinitas climatizadas de Arakur. Traslado privado al aeropuerto para su vuelo de conexión internacional vía Buenos Aires.

included: Todos los traslados en vehículos 4x4 y SUV premium privados
9 noches de alojamiento en hoteles 5 estrellas y estancias Relais & Châteaux

title: Maravillas del Altiplano & Lago Titicaca
tagline: La cuna mística de las civilizaciones andinas en el lago navegable más alto del mundo.
subtitle: La Paz de Vanguardia, Complejo Tiwanaku e Isla del Sol en catamarán privado
overview: Descubra los secretos ancestrales de Bolivia en un recorrido de inmersión cultural de alto nivel. Sobrevuele La Paz en la red urbana de teleféricos más moderna del planeta, admire la arquitectura ceremonial de Tiwanaku y navegue hacia el corazón del Lago Titicaca en embarcación privada hacia la mística Isla del Sol.
highlights: Experiencia gastronómica privada en Gustu (restaurante de alta cocina boliviana fundada por Claus Meyer)
Paseo aéreo en teleféricos de La Paz y exploración del surrealista Valle de la Luna
Visita arqueológica privada al templo de Kalasasaya y la Puerta del Sol en Tiwanaku
Navegación exclusiva en catamarán por el Lago Titicaca y pernocte en eco-lodge en la Isla del Sol

itinerary.title: Llegada a La Paz - Aclimatación en Hotel Boutique
itinerary.description: Recepción VIP en el Aeropuerto Internacional de El Alto (4,061 m) y descenso inmediato a la zona sur de La Paz (3,200 m). Check-in en Casa Grande Hotel o Atix Hotel.
itinerary.meals: Té de bienvenida andino, Cena ligera

itinerary.title: La Paz Aérea, Mercados Tradicionales & Arquitectura Cholet
itinerary.description: Recorrido por la red de teleféricos Mi Teleférico, visita al místico Mercado de las Brujas y recorrido arquitectónico por los deslumbrantes Cholets de El Alto.

itinerary.title: Misterios de Tiwanaku & Altiplano Ancestral
itinerary.description: Viaje privado al complejo arqueológico de Tiwanaku, centro espiritual y político preincaico. Visita a la Pirámide de Akapana y el monolito Ponce con arqueólogo privado.

itinerary.title: Rumbo a Copacabana & Lago Sagrado Titicaca
itinerary.description: Traslado escénico a través de los llanos del altiplano hacia el estrecho de Tiquina y la bahía de Copacabana. Visita al santuario de la Virgen de Copacabana.
itinerary.meals: Desayuno, Almuerzo de trucha del lago

itinerary.title: Catamarán Privado a la Isla del Sol
itinerary.description: Navegación privada por las aguas cristalinas del Titicaca hasta la Isla del Sol. Caminata por las terrazas incaicas de Yumani y la Fuente de la Eterna Juventud.

itinerary.title: Amanecer Sagrado & Isla de la Luna
itinerary.description: Amanecer inolvidable sobre la Cordillera Real reflejada en el lago. Navegación hacia la Isla de la Luna para explorar el Iñak Uyu (Palacio de las Vírgenes del Sol).

itinerary.title: Retorno a La Paz & Cena de Clausura en Gustu
itinerary.description: Retorno privado a La Paz con parada en miradores cordilleranos. Noche de gala con menú degustación de 8 pasos maridado con vinos bolivianos de altura en Gustu.
itinerary.meals: Desayuno, Cena de gala en Gustu

itinerary.title: Despedida de Bolivia
itinerary.description: Desayuno buffet andino y traslado privado con asistencia personalizada al aeropuerto de El Alto para su conexión internacional.

included: Recepción personalizada y traslados privados en vehículos con oxígeno medicinal
7 noches en hoteles 5 estrellas y eco-lodges de diseño seleccionados
Navegaciones privadas en catamarán en Lago Titicaca
Cena de gala en el prestigioso restaurante Gustu

title: Andes Coloniales & Crucero Exclusivo en Galápagos
tagline: Patrimonio colonial barroco y la mayor sinfonía de evolución natural del planeta.
subtitle: Quito histórico, Volcán Cotopaxi y 5 días en yate de expedición de lujo en Galápagos
overview: Un viaje extraordinario que fusiona el esplendor arquitectónico del Quito colonial con la majestuosidad de la Avenida de los Volcanes y una travesía íntima por el Archipiélago de Galápagos a bordo de un megayate de lujo con naturalistas certificados por el Parque Nacional.
highlights: Estadía en Casa Gangotena Relais & Châteaux en el corazón del centro histórico de Quito
Crucero de 5 días en megayate de lujo con ratio privilegiado de pasajeros por naturalista
Snorkel privado con leones marinos juguetones, tortugas verdes y pingüinos de Galápagos
Almuerzo campestre en hacienda andina histórica con vista directa al glaciar del Cotopaxi

itinerary.title: Bienvenida a Quito - Centro Histórico Patrimonio UNESCO
itinerary.description: Llegada al Aeropuerto Mariscal Sucre y traslado en vehículo privado a Casa Gangotena frente a la Plaza San Francisco. Brindis con infusiones andinas en la terraza.

itinerary.title: Tesoros Coloniales de Quito & Mitad del Mundo
itinerary.description: Visita privada a la Iglesia de la Compañía de Jesús y el Monasterio de San Francisco. Experiencia exclusiva en la Línea Ecuatorial con experimentos de física gravitacional.

itinerary.title: Avenida de los Volcanes & Parque Nacional Cotopaxi
itinerary.description: Excursión hacia el cono nevado perfecto del Volcán Cotopaxi (5,897 m). Caminata suave por la Laguna de Limpiopungo y almuerzo tradicional en Hacienda San Agustín de Callo.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a Galápagos - Embarque en Yate de Expedición
itinerary.description: Vuelo privado hacia la Isla Baltra en Galápagos. Recepción preferencial por guías naturalistas y traslado al megayate de expedición. Cóctel del capitán y primera charla de navegación.

itinerary.title: Isla Santa Cruz: Tortugas Gigantes & Túneles de Lava
itinerary.description: Desembarco en Puerto Ayora para visitar las tierras altas donde habitan tortugas gigantes en estado silvestre. Exploración de túneles de lava volcánica y estación científica Charles Darwin.

itinerary.title: Isla Española: Albatros de Galápagos & Punta Suárez
itinerary.description: Caminata por los acantilados de lava donde anidan los majestuosos albatros de las Galápagos y piqueros de patas azules. Snorkel en Gardner Bay con leones marinos.

itinerary.title: Isla Floreana: Bahía Post Office & Corona del Diablo
itinerary.description: Visita al histórico barril de correos del siglo XVIII en Post Office Bay. Inmersión de snorkel en la Corona del Diablo, uno de los mejores puntos marinos del mundo.

itinerary.title: Isla Bartolomé: El Icónico Pináculo & Pingüinos
itinerary.description: Ascenso de 372 escalones al mirador más fotografiado de Galápagos con vista al Pináculo de Bartolomé. Snorkel junto a pingüinos ecuatoriales y tiburones de arrecife de punta blanca.

itinerary.title: Isla Fernandina & Canal Bolívar
itinerary.description: Exploración de la isla volcánica más prístina del archipiélago en Punta Espinosa: miles de iguanas marinas tomando el sol sobre lava negra y cormoranes no voladores.

itinerary.title: Desembarco en Baltra & Vuelo a Guayaquil
itinerary.description: Última salida matutina en panga y desembarco. Vuelo de regreso al continente (Guayaquil). Check-in en Hotel del Parque dentro de los jardines botánicos de Samborondón.

itinerary.title: Conexión Internacional
itinerary.description: Desayuno en el claustro histórico del hotel y traslado privado al aeropuerto internacional para su vuelo de retorno a casa.

Vuelos internacionales hacia y desde Ecuador

tagline: Aromas de café especial, palmas de cera gigantes y el romanticismo amurallado de Cartagena.

Descubra los secretos del grano de café más suave del mundo en haciendas patrimoniales de montaña, camine bajo las palmas de cera más altas del planeta en el Valle de Cocora y ríndase al encanto caribeño en el interior amurallado de Cartagena de Indias.
highlights: Acceso privado al Museo del Oro en Bogotá y cena de autor en Leo (Leonor Espinosa)
Cata de cafés especiales guiada por barista profesional en hacienda privada del Eje Cafetero
Paseo en Jeep Willys tradicional por el Valle de Cocora y Salento colonial
Crucero privado al atardecer en catamarán por la Bahía de Cartagena con champaña y tapas caribeñas

itinerary.title: Llegada a Bogotá - Capital de Altura
itinerary.description: Recepción VIP en el Aeropuerto El Dorado y traslado al Four Seasons Hotel Casa Medina en el exclusivo distrito financiero. Cena de autor en el restaurante estrella de la ciudad.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Seasons Hotel Casa Medina Bogotá

itinerary.title: Centro Histórico La Candelaria & Museo Botero
itinerary.description: Paseo privado por las callejuelas adoquinadas de La Candelaria, visita guiada al Museo Botero y la deslumbrante colección de orfebrería prehispánica del Museo del Oro.
itinerary.accommodation: Four Seasons Hotel Casa Medina Bogotá

itinerary.title: Vuelo al Eje Cafetero - Hacienda Tradicional
itinerary.description: Vuelo a Armenia o Pereira y traslado a Hacienda Bambusa, inmersa en plantaciones de café y plátano. Tarde relajante junto a la piscina con vista a la cordillera.

itinerary.title: Valle de Cocora & Palma de Cera en Jeep Willys
itinerary.description: Excursión en icónico Jeep Willys privado hacia el Valle de Cocora para admirar las imponentes palmas de cera de hasta 60 metros. Visita a los artesanos de Salento y Filandia.

itinerary.title: La Magia del Grano al Pocillo
itinerary.description: Jornada inmersiva en cafetal de especialidad aprendiendo la recolección manual selectiva, el despulpe y la cata profesional con barista premiado.

itinerary.title: Vuelo a Cartagena de Indias - El Bastión del Caribe
itinerary.description: Vuelo hacia Cartagena. Check-in en el legendario Hotel Sofitel Legend Santa Clara (antiguo convento de Clarisas del siglo XVII). Paseo crepuscular en coche de época por las murallas.

itinerary.title: Islas del Rosario en Yate Privado & Atardecer Amurallado
itinerary.description: Día de navegación privada en lancha de lujo hacia las aguas turquesas del archipiélago de las Islas del Rosario. Almuerzo caribeño con langosta y regreso para cena de gala.

itinerary.title: Despedida de Colombia
itinerary.description: Mañana libre para compras de esmeraldas colombianas con gemólogo de confianza o masaje en el spa del Santa Clara. Traslado privado al aeropuerto para su vuelo internacional.
